title: Senior Engineer I, Field service
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Step into a career with ASM, where cutting edge technology meets collaborative culture. </strong>​</p> <p>For over 55 years ASM has been ahead of what’s next, at the forefront of innovation and what’s technologically possible. With more than 4,500 ASMers representing 70 nationalities, our people and our advanced semiconductor devices are playing a crucial role in trends such as 5G, cloud computing, AI, and autonomous driving. But&nbsp;we’re more than just a tech company. We value diversity, inclusion and sustainability as we strive to make a positive impact on the world.&nbsp; Our development programs help support your growth, shaping your future and pushing the boundaries of innovation to unleash potential.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p></div><p>ASM is a leading global provider of products, services, and materials for semiconductor processing. Innovation has been at the heart of everything we do for over half a century. The brilliant minds at ASM are dedicated to developing groundbreaking solutions for the world's leading semiconductor manufacturers. Every day, we drive the development of next-generation computer chip technologies, staying a few steps ahead of the future. Our talented and enthusiastic employees are just like you: committed to improving people's lives and unlocking new possibilities. Through a collaborative approach to research and development, we advance key semiconductor technologies and platforms such as ALD, epitaxy, PEALD, PECVD, and vertical furnaces. We have also recently entered the promising growth market of silicon carbide epitaxy. Year after year, our innovations help make chips smaller, faster, and more powerful. In fact, you can find our technology in every aspect of modern life: in artificial intelligence, medical devices, 5G, smartphones, autonomous driving, and more.</p> <p><strong>Your responsibilities:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Performing installations, implementing new developments, and conducting qualification procedures, as well as carrying out preventive and corrective maintenance on complex electronic/electromechanical semiconductor equipment at ASM customer sites</li> <li>Performing repairs during equipment downtime, collaborating in diverse teams, and developing and presenting proposed solutions</li> <li>Working on-site at various customer locations within cleanroom environments</li> </ul> <p>Willingness to travel: Within the ASM Europe region, we have many customers spread across the entire area. Therefore, a willingness to travel for business—both within Germany and to other European countries—is a requirement. Due to ASM’s growing international presence and expanding customer base, occasional business trips to North America or Asia may also be necessary.</p> <p><strong>Our Profile:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree in Mechatronics, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or Electronics (or equivalent knowledge); applications from certified master craftsmen and technicians are also welcome</li> <li>Experience using measuring instruments and hand tools</li> <li>Strong verbal and written communication skills (German and English)</li> <li>Proficiency in MS Office; SAP knowledge is an advantage</li> <li>The ideal candidate brings initial professional experience in field service or customer support and has gained experience in the assembly and commissioning of systems, preferably within the semiconductor industry</li> <li>We also welcome applications from suitable entry-level candidates</li> <li>Class B driver’s license mandatory</li> </ul> <p><strong>What we offer at ASM:</strong></p> <ul> <li>The opportunity to work for a leading provider of semiconductor process equipment</li> <li>A varied and dynamic international environment</li> <li>An attractive salary package</li> <li>Company car for business and private use</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>At ASM, we are committed to supporting our employees and empowering them to develop their talents and perform at their best. We actively foster an inclusive and diverse culture built on trust and transparency. Our people are our strength, and we value the differences each individual brings, as they make us a better team. By embracing a wide range of perspectives, we cultivate a culture of continuous exploration and the adoption of new ideas. At every step, we recognize that it is our valued employees who enable us to deliver outstanding products and services to our customers—and to make a positive impact on society.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>Join us on our journey. Discover how you can be part of our exciting future and apply today! To learn more about ASM, visit us at asm.com and on LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, and YouTube.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Apply today to be part of what’s next.</strong></p> <p>We make the tech that enables the chips in devices which improve lives around the world. We do this with an eye to the future, pushing the boundaries of what’s possible through cutting-edge innovation, and driving the next wave of technological breakthroughs that shape how we live, work, and connect.</p> <p class="x_elementToProof">To learn more about ASM, find us at&nbsp;<a href="https://www.asm.com/" target="_blank">asm.com</a> and&nbsp;on <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/asm/" target="_blank">LinkedIn</a>,&nbsp;<a href="https://www.facebook.com/ASMOfficialCompany" target="_blank">Facebook</a>,&nbsp;<a href="https://www.instagram.com/asmofficialcompany/" target="_blank">Instagram,</a>&nbsp;<a href="https://twitter.com/ASMofficialco" target="_blank">X&nbsp;</a>and&nbsp;<a href="https://www.youtube.com/c/ASM_Official" target="_blank">YouTube</a>.</p> <hr> <p class="x_elementToProof"><em>ASM is an equal opportunity employer and considers qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, nationality, social or ethnic origin, sexual orientation, gender, gender identify or expression, marital status, pregnancy, political affiliation, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.</em></p></div> Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

Outreach & Pipeline Building: Own the top of the funnel for our partnerships pipeline. Proactively reach out to prospective partners via email, LinkedIn, events, and other channels. Relationship Building & Support: Assist in building and maintaining strong working relationships with partners. Team Player: You collaborate closely with teammates and internal stakeholders to deliver joint results. title: (Senior) Accountant (w/m/d)
description: ZEAL Network SE ist eine international tätige Unternehmensgruppe und Deutschlands führender Anbieter von Online-Lotterien mit den Marken LOTTO24 und Tipp24. Gemeinsam mit Partnern wie ONCE sowie innovativen Angeboten wie Freiheit+, Traumhausverlosung, Traumautoverlosung und ZEAL Ventures gestalten wir die Zukunft digitaler Lotterien und investieren in neue Geschäftsmodelle. Unser vielfältiges Team aus über 350 Mitarbeitenden verbindet Innovationsgeist, Zusammenarbeit und das gemeinsame Ziel, Menschen dabei zu unterstützen, ihre Träume zu verwirklichen. Deine Aufgaben: Du übernimmst Verantwortung für zentrale Themen der Hauptbuchhaltung, insbesondere Rückstellungen, personalbezogene Buchungen sowie Kontenabstimmungen. Du bist aktiv an der Erstellung von Monats- und Jahresabschlüssen nach IFRS und deren Überleitung nach HGB für die dir zugeordneten Konzerngesellschaften beteiligt und arbeitest dabei eng mit Controlling, Group Reporting und weiteren Finance-Teams (z. B. Nebenbücher, Tax, Treasury und Investor Relatons), sowie anderen Stakeholdern zusammen. Du treibst die kontinuierliche Verbesserung und Automatisierung von Prozessen voran, denkst innovativ und stellst die Einhaltung von Bilanzierungsrichtlinien sowie internen Kontrollsystemen (ICS) sicher. Du pflegst und optimierst relevante Prozessdokumentationen. Du unterstützt aktiv bereichsübergreifende Projekte, insbesondere rund um unsere Online-Plattform sowie bei der Einführung neuer Produkte oder Features. Du trägst durch eine präzise und termingerechte Buchhaltung wesentlich zur Qualität unserer Finanzberichterstattung bei und übernimmst Verantwortung für buchhalterische Themen innerhalb des Hauptbuch-Teams. Was du mitbringst: Du hast mindestens 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Finanzbuchhaltung bzw. Hauptbuchhaltung. Du verfügst über sehr gute Kenntnisse in MS Excel, sowie gängigen Buchhaltungssystemen (MS Dynamics Business Central oder MS Dynamics NAV sind ein Plus). Du arbeitest selbstständig, strukturiert und zuverlässig und zeichnest dich durch eine proaktive Kommunikation aus. Idealerweise hast du Erfahrung mit Cash Management Software (E-Banking Treasurysysteme). Eine Weiterbildung als Bilanzbuchhalter*in oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation ist von Vorteil. Erfahrungen mit FloQast oder vergleichbaren Reporting- bzw. Abschlussmanagement-Tools sind ein Plus. Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift. Was wir anbieten: Eine moderne, dynamische Unternehmenskultur, basierend auf dem Erfolg eines innovativen E-Commerce-Unternehmens. Ein talentiertes Team aus ambitionierten, gleichgesinnten Kolleg*innen, in dem dein Wissen und deine Ideen wirklich etwas bewegen. Kontinuierliche persönliche Weiterentwicklung, unterstützt durch ein jährliches Weiterbildungsbudget von 1.500 €, das du in deine berufliche Entwicklung investieren kannst. Vertrauen und Eigenverantwortung – kein Mikromanagement, sondern echtes Vertrauen in deine Fähigkeiten, hervorragende Ergebnisse zu liefern. B. das Deutschlandticket), sowie Zugang zu einem Fahrrad-Leasing-Programm. Betriebliche Altersvorsorge in Zusammenarbeit mit Degura zur Absicherung deiner finanziellen Zukunft. Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for Mobile developer to build the native Android experience for BJAK's AI Finance Agent.

This role is for someone who cares about clean user flows, fast performance, product quality and shipping reliable mobile features used by real customers.

What You'll Own

  • Build and ship Android features using Kotlin.

  • Create clean mobile flows for insurance, payments, claims, renewals and financial services.

  • Work with product and design to simplify complex user journeys.

  • Integrate backend APIs and ensure mobile flows are stable, secure and reliable.

  • Improve app performance, crash rate, loading states, responsiveness and memory usage.

  • Use analytics, user behaviour and production issues to improve the product.

  • Build AI-assisted mobile experiences only where they genuinely improve the user journey.

What We're Looking For

  • 3+ years of Android development experience using Kotlin.

  • Strong Android fundamentals and experience shipping production apps.

  • Good knowledge of Jetpack, Coroutines, Flow and modern Android architecture.

  • Strong sense of mobile UX, usability, edge cases and user flows.

  • Experience integrating REST APIs and debugging production issues.

  • Fast execution, high ownership and strong attention to product quality.

  • App links, GitHub, screenshots or examples of shipped work are a strong advantage.

Tech Stack

  • Kotlin

  • Jetpack Compose

  • Android SDK

  • Coroutines & Flow

  • SQL / NoSQL

  • TensorFlow Lite (on-device inference)

The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Thinks in user journeys, not just screens.

  • Cares about making complex financial products feel simple.

  • Moves fast without creating messy code.

  • Notices UX, performance and reliability issues before users complain.

  • Honest about what they personally built, what was team-owned and what impact they can or cannot claim.

This Role Is Not For

  • Engineers who only want fully defined tickets.

  • Developers who build screens without caring about user experience.

  • People who ignore crashes, edge cases, loading states or performance.

  • Engineers who move slowly in a startup environment.

  • People who exaggerate impact without explaining their actual contribution.

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Germany. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Germany.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Role-specific interview

  3. CEO / final round


For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

Bei GALVANY ist es unser Ziel, klimaneutrales Wohnen für alle zur Realität zu machen. Wir setzen auf Umsetzung und entwickeln konkrete, smarte Lösungen, indem wir Wärmepumpen, Batteriespeicher und Smart Metering einfach zugänglich, zuverlässig und bezahlbar machen.

Wir sind ein profitables Greentech-Startup und glauben, dass nachhaltiger Impact und langfristiges Wachstum nur auf Basis eines gesunden Geschäftsmodells möglich sind. Getrieben von Kundennutzen, Klarheit und Verantwortung stehen wir für hochwertige Heizlösungen und ein Arbeitsumfeld, in dem Menschen Verantwortung übernehmen und nachhaltigen Mehrwert schaffen.

Als Werkstudent (m/w/d) im Partner Sales unterstützt du unser Team bei der Betreuung unseres externen Vertriebsnetzwerks aus rund 300 aktiven Handelsvertretern, die unsere Wärmepumpen- und Energiesysteme direkt bei Hausbesitzenden vertreiben. Du hilfst dabei, eine hohe Beratungsqualität sicherzustellen, und trägst zu einem reibungslosen Übergang von Verkauf zu Umsetzung bei.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Ansprechperson für unsere externen Handelsvertreter im Tagesgeschäft.

  • Prüfung eingehender Verträge auf Vollständigkeit, Plausibilität und technische Baubarkeit (z. B. Gebäudedaten, Objektfotos, Aufstellorte).

  • Statusverfolgung von Finanzierungen bei externen Partnern (z. B. Clover) sowie Datenpflege im CRM.

  • Tracking der Sales Performance des Vertriebsnetzwerks in Airtable und Unterstützung beim Reporting.

  • Mitorganisation von Events für externe Handelsvertreter.

  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Operations, Installation und Finance.

Dein Profil

  • Immatrikulation in einem betriebswirtschaftlichen oder technischen Studiengang.

  • 20h pro Woche verfügbar.

  • Sicherer Umgang mit digitalen Tools, neue Software erlernst du schnell.

  • Fließende Deutschkenntnisse.

Zusätzlich sind uns folgende Fähigkeiten und Eigenschaften wichtig:

  • Reliable Executor: Du hältst Termine und Deadlines zuverlässig ein und lieferst gleichbleibend hohe Qualität ab.

  • Technical Understanding: Du verstehst bautechnische Zusammenhänge schnell und überträgst sie präzise in unser Feinplanungstool.

  • Customer-Facing Communicator: Du trittst Kund:innen gegenüber freundlich und kompetent auf und schaffst auch im Online-Termin eine vertrauensvolle Atmosphäre.

  • Adaptive Problem Solver: Du denkst mit, behältst auch in unklaren Situationen den Überblick und suchst pragmatisch nach Lösungen, statt bei Hindernissen stehen zu bleiben.

Benefits:

  • Werde Teil eines schnell wachsenden und profitablen Climate-Tech-Startups

  • Attraktive und wettbewerbsfähige Vergütung

  • Unser lebendiges Office ist das Herz unserer Kultur und fördert Zusammenarbeit und Austausch vor Ort

  • Hybrides Arbeitsmodell mit anteiligem Homeoffice nach der Einarbeitung

  • Individuelle Benefits, abgestimmt auf deine Bedürfnisse, z. B. Sportmitgliedschaften, ÖPNV-Ticket oder Learning Budget

raw.title: Mechanical Design Engineering Team Lead
raw.description:
About pplwise

pplwise is a recruiting consultancy for fast-growing technology companies across Europe. Through Recruiting as a Service and Executive Search, we fill key roles for our clients, from start-ups to publicly listed companies. We are filling this position for our client Filics.

About our client: Filics

Filics is reinventing intralogistics with autonomous mobile robots (AMRs) that change how material moves. Its double-runner system makes Filics the first and only AMR that can drive through load carriers such as Euro pallets. This breaks with forklift logic and sets a new standard for efficiency. Filics is a small, hands-on team that solves hard problems with engineering excellence. Leadership goes to those who take initiative and consistently deliver. As Senior Mechanical Design Engineer (m/f/d) at Filics, you will lead the mechanical design of the robots as they move from prototype to series production.

About the role

This is an on-site/hybrid role in Munich, close to engineering and assembly.

Filics builds its own robot hardware in-house: mechanics, electronics and software. Orders are growing, and the robots are moving from prototypes to series production. Designs that worked in the lab now need to be built reliably, at scale and at the right cost. The hardest problems often sit between disciplines: parts that work on their own can fail once they're assembled with the electronics.

The mechanical team has four engineers, most of them at the start of their careers, and they need someone who guides them every day. You'll be the technical lead for the mechanical side of the product and the counterpart to the electronics lead, so the current mechanical manager can focus on core R&D. Your time splits roughly evenly between hands-on engineering and technical leadership. You'll work closely with Electronics, Production, Procurement and the CTO, and you'll set the engineering habits while the team is still small.

What you'll do

  • Mentor the mechanical engineers day to day: help them make design decisions, set methods and keep projects focused

  • Design parts and assemblies in CAD, including tolerancing, and check every design for manufacturability and cost before it goes out

  • Lead testing and integration of mechanics and electronics, and solve the problems that only show once everything is assembled

  • Prioritise incoming work, follow up on progress and make the day-to-day technical calls on the mechanical side

  • Make the gated design process work in practice and run design reviews (safety, mechanics, electronics, manufacturability) before parts are integrated

  • Put design for manufacturing and design for cost in place: fewer, standardised parts and production methods that scale

  • Work with the electronics owner of each robot module from the first prototype on, and with Production on manufacturability and production jigs

  • Build and iterate prototypes based on customer and field feedback

About you

  • Several years of hands-on mechanical design in R&D at a company that develops and builds its own electromechanical products (e.g. power tools, home appliances, e-mobility, production machines, robotics, marine propulsion)

  • A proven record of taking an electromechanical product from prototype to series production (ideally 1,000+ units a year) on a fast development cycle of about a year, not a decade-long program

  • You still design hands-on in CAD, mainly metal parts and assemblies, with strong tolerancing skills (any CAD tool; Onshape is a plus)

  • You've applied design for manufacturing and design for cost, and cut cost through design: fewer parts, standard parts

  • At least two years of mentoring or technically guiding other engineers; a team-lead title isn't required

  • Experience testing and integrating mechanics with electronics

  • You've introduced processes, design reviews or engineering standards that helped a team deliver

  • You handle unclear requirements and break complex problems down so others can work on them

  • German is a plus, since production is mostly German-speaking

  • Bonus: GD&T and tolerance stack-ups, design of production jigs, or projects with motors, motor controllers or electronics

What Filics offers

  • A key role at an early stage: shape both the mechanical team and the product

  • Real ownership of the mechanical side, from first prototype to series production

  • A mix of hands-on engineering and leadership, with a path into team lead and engineering management as Filics grows

  • Fast design cycles driven by customer and field feedback

  • A small, high-caliber team with close collaboration across mechanics, electronics, software and production

  • Fast growth: one year at Filics teaches you what usually takes many years at a large company

  • An on-site/hybrid role in Munich, close to Engineering and Assembly

Sound like you? Apply with your CV.

BoWatt is building AI agents for requirements and systems engineering in manufacturing. We help the teams engineering cars, planes, rockets, factories, chips, and medical devices tackle complex engineering work with software.

We bootstrapped to €500k+ ARR before raising our first round. Our investors include Atlantic Foodlabs, Buildery (CDTM affiliates), and Prequel Ventures, alongside angels from Cohere and Luminovo.

Now we’re looking for an ambitious Account Executive to turn customer interest into closed deals.

The role

You want to become exceptional at selling. You’re early in your sales career, but you’ve already shown that you learn fast, create opportunities, and take ownership of results.

At BoWatt, you’ll own your pipeline from first conversation to signed customer. You’ll sell a technical product to manufacturing companies across DACH, learn directly from our CEO, and help turn what works into a repeatable sales process.

This is a hands-on individual-contributor role, not a sales-management position. You don’t need to have built a sales team. You do need the drive and judgement to move deals forward without waiting for a finished playbook.

What you’ll do

  • Build pipeline through targeted outbound, alongside leads generated with BDR support.

  • Run discovery with engineering and business stakeholders to understand their workflows, pain points, and buying process.

  • Deliver tailored product demos and build a clear business case for BoWatt.

  • Own opportunities through qualification, pilot discussions, negotiation, and close.

  • Keep your CRM and forecasts accurate, with clear next steps for every opportunity.

  • Bring customer feedback to the product team and help improve our messaging, demos, and sales process.

What you bring

  • Early experience in B2B software or technical sales. You may already be closing deals as an AE, or be a standout SDR/BDR ready to take on the full sales cycle.

  • Evidence that you perform: targets exceeded, pipeline you created, deals you helped win, rapid progression, or a business you built yourself. We care more about what you’ve done than your title or years of experience.

  • The curiosity to understand a technical product and explain its value clearly. Manufacturing experience helps, but isn’t required.

  • Strong communication: you ask good questions, listen carefully, and make the next step clear.

  • Resilience and initiative. You follow up, handle rejection, and find ways to make progress.

  • Fluent German and professional English, our internal working language.

  • Willingness to work from our Munich office four days per week.

What we offer

  • Competitive base salary plus uncapped commission.

  • Meaningful equity

  • Close collaboration with the CEO and hands-on onboarding into our product, customers, and industry.

  • Ownership of real customer relationships and room to take on larger deals and greater responsibility as you develop.

  • A small team of experienced startup builders and former founders.

  • 25 vacation days plus public holidays, company retreats, and WellPass membership.

Interview process

  1. 20-minute introductory call.

  2. 90-minute sales interview with the CEO and a team member.

  3. 60-minute culture and team interview.

  4. References and offer.


We aim to complete the process within 14 days.

title: Werkstudent (M/W/D)
description: Was wir tun Als IoT-Pioniere entwickeln wir mit mittlerweile über 50 Kolleginnen und Kollegen an drei Standorten IoT-Komplettlösungen für unsere Kunden. Aktuell sind weltweit über 750.000 Geräte und Anlagen mit unseren Lösungen für Machine-to-Machine-Kommunikation ausgestattet. Unsere Kompetenz liegt in der Entwicklung kundenspezifischer IoT-Lösungen, basierend auf unserer Erfahrung, unseren erprobten Software-Bausteinen und einer Vielzahl von bereits realisierten Projekten. Unser Team Seit der Firmengründung im Jahr 2004 sind wir stetig gewachsen und haben uns in diesem Markt über die Jahre als starker Partner der Industrie etabliert. Damit das auch so bleibt, erweitern wir kontinuierlich unser Team mit talentierten und qualifizierten Entwickler*innen. Durch vielseitige Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten, Teilnahme an Konferenzen und Workshops sowie eine ausgeprägte Feedback-Kultur heben wir unser Team auf die nächste Stufe. Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt Werkstudenten an den Standorten BISSENDORF bei Osnabrück), GARBSEN (bei Hannover)und BERLIN Einstieg als Werkstudent*In Werkstudent*innen arbeiten neben ihrem Studium in einem Unternehmen. Wenn Du Informatik oder ein ähnliches Studium absolvierst und gerne Software programmierst – könntest Du zu uns passen. Als Werkstudent*in wirst Du bei uns voll in die Arbeitsprozesse integriert, lernst strategisch zu denken, zu präsentieren, Projekte zu managen, eignest Dir Soft Skills an, wie den Umgang mit Kollegen*innen, Verhalten bei Stress und Kritikfähigkeit. Der Status als Werkstudent*in sorgt dafür, dass Du mehr Geld von Deinem Job behältst, denn als Werkstudent*in musst du keine Beiträge zur Kranken-, Pflege- und Arbeitslosenversicherung bezahlen. ES MÜSSEN VOR ALLEM ZWEI VORAUSSETZUNGEN ERFÜLLT SEIN, DAMIT DU ALS WERKSTUDENT*IN ANGEMELDET WERDEN KANNST UND VOM WERKSTUDENT*INNEN-PRIVILEG PROFITIERST: Du musst in einem Vollzeitstudium immatrikuliert sein (nicht im Urlaubssemester). Du darfst maximal 20 Stunden pro Woche arbeiten (in der vorlesungsfreien Zeit ist mehr möglich). Du bist neugierig auf das Berufsleben? Wir laden Dich ein, Teil unseres Teams zu werden! DEIN AUFGABENGEBIET ALS WERKSTUDENT*IN Du unterstützt bei der Entwicklung von Anwendungen im M2M / IoT-Umfeld. mit Java oder C/C++ auf embedded Linuxsystemen oder mit Java in der Backend-Entwicklung oder mit JavaScript in der Frontend-Entwicklung. Du nimmst an Schulungen teil und bildest dich eigenständig weiter. Du entwickelst Software im Team mit Tools wie GitLab, Maven, Node, JIRA, Confluence, u.a. Du unterstützt unsere Kunden bei laufenden Projekten. DEIN PROFIL Du hast bereits Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung gesammelt. Du bist wissbegierig und neue Technologien begeistern dich. Deine Freunde bezeichnen Dich als Nerd und das ist OK für dich. Du 'bastelst' gerne und hast Spaß daran mit Technologien Probleme des Alltags zu lösen. Du bist zuverlässig und arbeitest gewissenhaft. Du arbeitest gerne im Team Für dich ist geteiltes Wissen verdoppeltes Wissen. Wenn Du dich da wieder findest, kannst Du bei uns sicher einen Job finden, der Dich fachlich und Menschlich weiterbringt und dir dein Studium finanziell versüßt. Wir sind bestrebt unsere Werkstudent*innen auch nach dem Studim zu halten und freuen uns über alle studierenden, dessen Vertrag in einen festen Arbeitsvertrag übergeht. title: Product Manager MISSION AIRCRAFT (m/f/d)
description: About the role: As Product Manager Mission Aircraft, you will own the product strategy, roadmap and lifecycle of our military multi-mission aircraft. The aircraft is designed as an optionally piloted platform combining manned and unmanned operations with modular mission capabilities for applications such as Counter-UxS, ISR, maritime and border patrol, training and manned-unmanned teaming. You will work at the intersection of customer needs, operational requirements, engineering feasibility and commercial viability. In close collaboration with Engineering, Operations, Sales, Product Marketing and other stakeholders, you will translate complex mission needs into clear product priorities and an executable roadmap. This end-to-end ownership, from customer discovery and product strategy through delivery and lifecycle development, is consistent with Quantum Systems' current Product Management model What is your Day to Day Mission: Own the product strategy and roadmap for the Mission Aircraft, translating market, customer and operational requirements into clear product priorities and measurable outcomes. Drive customer and market discovery by engaging with end users, governmental customers, Sales and Solutions teams to understand operational challenges, mission scenarios and capability gaps. Shape the multi-mission capability roadmap across relevant applications such as Counter-UxS, ISR, maritime and border patrol, training and manned-unmanned teaming. Drive payload and mission-system integration such as radar, EO/IR, SIGINT, communications and other mission-specific payloads. Lead product trade-off decisions across performance, payload, endurance, platform constraints, cost, risk, certification and time-to-market. Own product readiness and lifecycle decisions, defining acceptance criteria and supporting validation, release readiness, market introduction and continuous product improvement. Create cross-functional alignment across Engineering, Operations, Programs, Sales, Product Marketing and external technology partners, clearly communicating priorities, dependencies, risks and roadmap decisions. What you bring to the team: You have completed a degree/apprenticeship in the field of ... You already have at least X years of professional/practical experience in ... You are privately interested in ... Due to your open, communicative, friendly and competent attitude, it is easy for you to be considered as an internal expert. You are highly self-motivated and drive your area of responsibility independently. Communication in English is a matter of course for you. Why Quantum-Systems: You have a degree in Aerospace Engineering, Systems Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Industrial Engineering or a comparable technical field. title: Business Development Manager (DACH)
description: Unser Kunde ist ein schnell wachsender europäischer Innovator im Bereich Baby-Mobilität und Lifestyle-Produkte. Das Unternehmen entwickelt und produziert preisgekrönte Kinderwagen, Buggys und Babyausstattung, die Stil, Sicherheit und Funktionalität verbinden und denen Tausende Eltern weltweit vertrauen. Hier werden mutige Ideen zu echten Produkten, die man auf den Straßen in Europa, Asien und darüber hinaus sieht. Mit einer starken internationalen Präsenz und einem wachsenden Vertriebsnetz verfolgt das Unternehmen ein klares Ziel: das Elternsein einfacher, smarter und stilvoller zu machen. Für Sie bedeutet das die Chance, Teil eines dynamischen, stark wachsenden Umfelds zu werden, in dem Ihre Vertriebsexpertise wirklich zählt. Hier werden Ergebnisse anerkannt, Eigeninitiative wird belohnt, und Karrieren wachsen mit dem globalen Erfolg des Unternehmens. Wir suchen Für das Team unseres Kunden suchen wir eine dynamische und motivierte Persönlichkeit mit ausgeprägter Vertriebsorientierung und einem klaren Fokus auf Ergebnisse, die die Position als Business Development Manager (DACH) übernimmt. In dieser Position sind Sie dafür verantwortlich, das Geschäftswachstum voranzutreiben und die Präsenz der Marke in DACH auszubauen. Dabei entwickeln und pflegen Sie starke und langfristige Beziehungen zu Kunden und Partnern. Ihre Hauptaufgaben Ausbau, Entwicklung und Betreuung des Kundenportfolios im Retail-Kanal zur Stärkung der Positionierung und Präsenz der Marke. Aufbau und Pflege starker, langfristiger Geschäftsbeziehungen zu Kunden und Partnern. Regelmäßige Durchführung von Produktpräsentationen für Store-Teams sowie Endverbraucher. Enge Zusammenarbeit mit den verschiedenen internen Abteilungen, um die erfolgreiche Umsetzung der Vertriebs- und Marketingstrategien sicherzustellen. Teilnahme an Messen, Ausstellungen, Kundenterminen und anderen relevanten Branchenveranstaltungen. Identifizierung neuer Geschäftsmöglichkeiten und aktive Unterstützung des Markenwachstums in der Region. Anforderungen Berufserfahrung im Bereich Baby- und Kinderprodukte bzw. im Bereich der Baby- und Kleinkindausstattung in DACH. Nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Erreichung von Vertriebszielen und im Business Development. Ausgezeichnete Kommunikations-, Verhandlungs- und Präsentationsfähigkeiten. Ausgeprägtes kommerzielles Verständnis und analytische Fähigkeiten. Fähigkeit, selbstständig zu arbeiten, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und mehrere Prioritäten gleichzeitig zu managen. Bereitschaft zu regelmäßigen Reisen innerhalb der zugewiesenen Region. Gute Englischkenntnisse für die Arbeit in einem internationalen Umfeld; Kenntnisse weiterer Sprachen sind von Vorteil. title: Senior Application Security Engineer (all genders)
description: Distribusion is the world’s leading ground transportation marketplace and gives travellers seamless access to ground transportation online, from search to ticket purchase. We have built a cutting-edge B2B technology platform that connects bus, rail and ferry operators in 70+ countries with the biggest online retailers including Google Maps and Booking.com. We are shaping the future of travel and building the largest global network of transport providers and retailers. We are one of the fastest growing startups in travel, backed by leading venture capital investors including TQ Ventures, Lightrock, Creandum, and Northzone, and are headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Following our recent $80m Series C funding, we are ready to push beyond. We are looking for our first dedicated Senior Application Security Engineer to build our AppSec practice from the ground up. This is a greenfield opportunity with a real attack surface: public partner-facing APIs and payment flows. You will own secure development, define what gets reviewed, implement security gates, build the "paved road" for ~150 engineers, and see the impact of your work in production within weeks. What you will do: Lead threat modeling and secure design reviews for high-risk changes, partner integrations, and payment flows. Implement, tune, and enforce security gates in GitLab CI/CD (SAST, SCA, secrets scanning, and DAST) while minimizing developer friction. Act as the primary technical owner for triaging, reproducing, and prioritizing findings from bug bounties, partner pentests, and automated scanners. Work hands-on with the DevOps team to implement GCP organizational policies, IAM least-privilege architectures, and Cloud Armor (WAF/rate limiting). Establish a security-champions network across engineering squads and leverage automation/AI-assisted tooling to scale code reviews effectively. Own vulnerability management end to end: a risk-ranked backlog, remediation SLAs, an escalation path, and closing findings together with the teams. Scope and coordinate the annual external penetration test and produce secure-development evidence for PCI-DSS and ISO 27001. Workplace: We are a remote-first company with teams located around the Globe and a HQ in Berlin. Who you are: You bring 5+ years in Product/Application Security (or 3+ years and a strong software engineering/web-pentesting background), with a track record of true ownership. You read and write production code (Python, Go, TypeScript, Ruby, etc.) and deeply understand web frameworks, CI/CD, and Kubernetes. You have deep knowledge of web and API security, specifically authentication/authorization models (OAuth2, JWT), rate limiting, tenant isolation, IDOR, and XSS. You have strong cloud security fundamentals (GCP preferred), specifically regarding public exposure, secrets hygiene, and WAF rules. You have run threat modelling and secure design reviews on real systems (STRIDE or similar). Hands-on with SAST/SCA/secrets scanning in CI (Aikido, Semgrep, Snyk or similar). You prioritize by real-world risk, propose trade-offs rather than demanding perfection, and communicate complex risks plainly to engineers and leadership. Bonus Points: You have experience securing high-volume, multi-tenant B2B APIs and utilizing AI tooling to accelerate triage and review. What you can expect: You will join a fast-paced travel tech company with a flat organizational structure. You will have exciting opportunities, ownership, and responsibility and contribute directly to the success of the company. You will join an international team of talented and driven people with a clear mission. Expect your colleagues to inspire, support and challenge you every day! We have a flexible work policy with the option of working remotely and international opportunities arising as we continue to expand our global footprint – Our heart is in Berlin, but you’ll find us across the globe. You will get a competitive salary. Our hiring team for this role: Your Talent Partner (TP) and point of contact is Lorena Rebenciuc, and the Hiring Manager (HM) is Ilya Isakov. For any queries, contact your Talent Partner at Do you want to work on a product that is used by millions of people daily with a high load, availability and scalability, and most advanced technology?  Come join us! Im früheren Leben war er Data Scientist, Python-Enthusiast, ML-Evangelist, Contributor bei Apache Spark und MLflow, blahblahblah. Du bist unsere erste Einstellung und arbeitest vom ersten Tag an direkt mit uns beiden. Wir werden kontinuierlich wachsen. Du lernst viel von uns, und wir wollen auch von dir lernen: die neue Harness, die du am Wochenende getestet hast, den Hack, der einen Skill doppelt so gut macht. Was du bei uns machst Du baust AI-Systeme für unsere Kunden: Agenten, AI-Plattformen, Software Factories. Von der Architektur bis zum Betrieb. Du arbeitest an Strategieprojekten mit, in denen Unternehmen zu Builder Companies werden. Du arbeitest agentisch. Coding Agents sind bei uns das Standardwerkzeug für fast alles. Du probierst aus, was im AI-Umfeld neu erscheint, und bringst das Brauchbare in unsere Projekte. Du übernimmst Verantwortung in unseren eigenen Produkten und Ventures. Was du mitbringst AI ist dein Beruf und dein Hobby, und das schon seit Jahren. Du warst dabei, bevor es jeder war. Wenn im AI-Umfeld etwas Neues erscheint, hast du es ausprobiert, bevor andere davon gelesen haben. Egal ob Modell, Tool, Framework oder Hardware. Du baust lieber, als darüber zu reden. Du arbeitest selbstverständlich mit KI-Tools und schaffst wiederkehrende Handarbeit mit KI und Automatisierung ab. Perfektes Deutsch in Wort und Schrift, gutes Englisch. title: Director, Performance Creative Strategy – Casino
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2 class="job-details__description-header text-color-secondary font-family-secondary" data-bind="i18n: 'job-details.employer-description-title'">About Us</h2> <div class="job-details__description-content basic-formatter" data-bind="html: pageData().job.corporateDescription"> <div>Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting &amp; Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally.&nbsp;</div> </div> <p>&nbsp;</p></div><p><strong>Primary Focus:</strong></p> <p>As Director, Performance Creative Strategy at Fanatics Betting &amp; Gaming (FBG), you are responsible for defining the strategic priorities, audience opportunities and learning agenda that shape Fanatics Casino performance creative. You’ll uncover the hooks, angles and player insights most likely to resonate, translate them into clear, inspiring briefs for the internal creative team, and track performance to understand what works and why. This role is the strategic link between player insight, creative development and performance results, ensuring the right problems are being solved and that learnings continuously inform future briefs across acquisition, engagement and retention.</p> <p>This position reports directly to the Senior Director, Performance Creative &amp; GTM, and manages one Associate, Performance Creative.</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own the Casino performance creative strategy across paid social, app networks, CTV, affiliates and lifecycle, aligned with business priorities, audience insight and brand positioning.</li> <li>Build and evolve the Casino creative variation framework, mapping hooks, angles, reasons to believe, formats and offers to audience and funnel stage.</li> <li>Translate business objectives and player insight into clear, inspiring briefs for the internal creative agency, including scripts, hook variations and iteration briefs on winning concepts.</li> <li>Own the Casino testing agenda, defining what we want to learn, how we measure a win, and which tests run each month.</li> <li>Drive a high-velocity testing program across hooks, openers, formats, offers and creators, continuously improving hit rate and speed to learning.</li> <li>Partner with Media and Analytics to track creative performance, identify winners and fatigue early, and apply learnings to the next round of briefs.</li> <li>Write concise test readouts and maintain a living library of what works for Casino players.</li> <li>Identify and define the performance territories, audience tensions and messaging opportunities to support creative briefs</li> <li>Embed performance requirements into brand and full-funnel campaign briefs from the outset (in collaboration with integrated marketing and media), ensuring channel, audience, format and measurement needs are clear before creative development begins. Partner with the Casino Creative Studio to translate those requirements into effective creative, with the Studio retaining ownership of creative direction and execution.</li> <li>Advise Brand and agency partners on hooks, edits, cutdowns, aspect ratios and platform-native versions, so big campaign moments carry through to always-on performance and lifecycle.</li> <li>Source player insight, competitor ad libraries, creator content and platform trends to identify new angles and white space.</li> <li>Lead performance strategy/creative insight sessions and contribute a strong POV to creative brainstorms, working closely with the Casino Creative Studio.</li> <li>Present performance learnings and recommendations in GTM forums and monthly reviews, turning results into a clear story for senior leadership.</li> <li>Lead, mentor and develop an Associate, building their craft in briefing, analysis and testing.</li> </ul> <p><strong>How This Role Connects Across the Team:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Partners with the internal producer, who owns production timelines and delivery, to keep briefs, priorities and the content calendar aligned.</li> <li>Partners with the Casino Creative Studio and Integrated Marketing to shape high-quality output, providing direction and feedback while respecting executional ownership.</li> <li>Partners with Brand and Integrated Marketing to embed performance best practice into campaigns, ensuring work is both distinctive and built to perform across the funnel.</li> <li>Partners with Media, Analytics and CRM to define success measures, read results and feed learnings back into strategy.</li> <li>Works with Legal, Compliance and Creative Operations to keep all creative compliant and aligned with Responsible Gaming standards.</li> <li>Partner with the affiliates teams to produce UGC briefs aligned to channel best practice, adapting content that’s optimised for performance (via creative briefs)</li> </ul> <p><strong>Skills &amp; Qualifications:</strong></p> <ul> <li>8+ years of experience in creative strategy, performance creative or brand strategy, including 3+ years leading creative strategy for a fast-growing D2C brand, mobile app, gaming or casino business.</li> <li>Portfolio demonstrating hook-led, insight-driven creative and the performance results behind it.</li> <li>Deep knowledge of platform-native creative across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, Snap and app networks, including UGC and creator formats.</li> <li>Proven track record building and running creative testing programs at volume.</li> <li>Strong analytical skills, with the ability to read performance data, size results and translate them into clear recommendations.</li> <li>Excellent storytelling and writing skills, from a 6-second hook to a campaign narrative to an executive readout.</li> <li>Experience influencing brand and integrated campaigns across matrixed teams without direct ownership.</li> <li>Experience managing and developing direct reports.</li> <li>Willingness to travel occasionally for team meetings and Fanatics events.</li> </ul> <p>Depending on the role, your interview and onboarding experience may include in-person components, such as onsite interviews or Launching into Better: LIVE—a multi-day cultural immersion in New York City for full-time, non-seasonal hires. These sessions are designed to build connection and bring our culture to life, though specific travel and participation requirements will be confirmed based on your role and location. Your recruiter will provide clear guidance at each stage of the process.</p> <p>For information about our benefits, please visit&nbsp;<a href="https://benefitsatfanatics.com/">https://benefitsatfanatics.com/</a></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>#li-JM3</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p></p> <p>By submitting your application, you agree to our terms of service and acknowledge you have read our <a href="https://static1.squarespace.com/static/5ff494b9931735466ce28d5b/t/69de53bde2c02c25e9c38758/1776178110037/Candidate+Privacy+Policy+April+2026.pdf" target="_blank">Candidate Privacy Policy.</a></p> <p><em>Fanatics will never ask candidates for money, banking information, or other sensitive personal information as part of the interview process. If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Fanatics recruiting, please do not respond and report it&nbsp;</em><a ----- <p></p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: <h1><strong>About the Team</strong></h1> <p>The Sales team at SevenRooms is on a mission to reshape the hospitality industry by empowering operators to take control of their guest relationships. We’re a passionate, high-performing group of go-getters who act as trusted advisors to restaurants and hospitality groups around the world. We take a consultative approach to sales—identifying business gaps, crafting thoughtful solutions, and helping operators reduce reliance on third-party networks. We believe in the power of hospitality, and we’re proud to partner with businesses to streamline operations and deliver magical guest experiences every day.</p> <h1><strong>About the Role</strong></h1> <p>As an Account Executive, you’ll work directly with restaurants and hospitality groups to understand their business needs and recommend the best-fit SevenRooms solutions—from reservations and table management to online ordering and marketing automation. You’ll drive new business by adding operators to the platform and working closely with our onboarding and account teams to ensure a smooth and enthusiastic transition. This role plays a key part in helping hospitality operators thrive, combining strategic thinking, relationship-building, and product knowledge to deliver real impact.</p> <h1><strong>You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…</strong></h1> <ul> <li><strong>Build and Manage a Sales Pipeline</strong>. Identify and engage prospective restaurants and hospitality groups to grow your book of business.</li> <li><strong>Showcase the Platform.</strong> Present the value of SevenRooms through compelling demos and conversations that help operators understand how we can support their success.</li> <li><strong>Lead Sales from Start to Finish.</strong> Own the full sales cycle—from prospecting and pitching to negotiation, contracting, and go-live support.</li> <li><strong>Deliver Live Product Demos.</strong> Conduct live, engaging product walkthroughs both virtually and in person when needed.</li> <li><strong>Be a Trusted Partner.</strong> Build strong relationships with prospects and clients, always advocating for their success and acting as a true advisor throughout the process.</li> </ul> <h1><strong>We’re excited about you because…</strong></h1> <ul> <li>You have 3+ years of experience in hospitality technology sales</li> <li>You’re confident presenting to clients both in person and virtually</li> <li>You’re self-driven and comfortable working independently, whether in the office or remotely</li> <li>You’re tech-savvy and quick to pick up new tools and platforms</li> <li>You’re results-oriented and bring energy and focus to your daily work</li> <li>You’ve worked with tools like Salesforce, Outreach, or similar systems</li> <li>You have a background in hospitality or restaurants (a big plus!)</li> <li>You’re open to occasional travel into key markets to connect with clients face-to-face</li> <li style="font-weight: bold;"><strong>You speak fluent French</strong></li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p style="font-weight: 500;">Notice to Applicants for Jobs Located in NYC or Remote Jobs Associated With Office in NYC Only</p> <p>We use Covey as part of our hiring and/or promotional process for jobs in NYC and certain features may qualify it as an AEDT in NYC. As part of the hiring and/or promotion process, we provide Covey with job requirements and candidate submitted applications. We began using <a href="https://getcovey.com/product/covey-scout-inbound">Covey Scout for Inbound</a> from August 21, 2023, through December 21, 2023, and resumed using <a href="https://getcovey.com/product/covey-scout-inbound">Covey Scout for Inbound</a> again on June 29, 2024.</p> <p>The Covey tool has been reviewed by an independent auditor. Results of the audit may be viewed here: <a style="text-decoration: underline;" href="https://getcovey.com/nyc-local-law-144">Covey</a></p><div class="content-conclusion"><h1><strong>About SevenRooms</strong></h1> <p>In 2011, Joel Montaniel, Allison Page, and Kinesh Patel founded SevenRooms after noticing that hospitality operators were missing a critical ingredient in the systems they were using to run their business: guest data. The combination brings together DoorDash’s scale, reach, and digital innovation with SevenRooms’ in-store capabilities to support hospitality businesses across every channel — from discovery and delivery to on-premise dining.</p> <p>As DoorDash builds out its in-store capabilities, SevenRooms plays a central role in enabling merchants to grow their businesses and connect more meaningfully with guests, whether they’re ordering online or dining in. raw.title: Security Engineer
raw.description:
Who we are

At GetGround, our mission is to make property investment safer, faster and more accessible for everyone.

We’ve built an all-in-one property investment platform that supports investors from opportunity analysis and company formation through to financing, accounting and portfolio management. By bringing software, data and specialist services into one experience, we make property investing simpler, clearer and more cost-effective.

More than 30,000 investors across 70 countries trust us with their identity documents, company records, bank details and the financial picture of their portfolios. Several of our products are regulated by the FCA, and we’re now serving institutional clients and expanding into new markets.

Our security needs to grow faster than we do. We’re looking for someone to own it.

The opportunity

You’ll be GetGround’s first dedicated security engineer. This is a hands-on role with broad ownership. You’ll decide how we prevent, detect and respond to threats across our cloud, devices, identity and SaaS estate, and then build it.

The scope goes beyond configuring tools. You’ll run our SIEM and own our alerts, keep us ahead of a threat landscape that AI is changing fast, and make sure leadership knows where we stand and what we need.

You’ll work closely with our site reliability engineer, product engineers, our Compliance team and our Data Protection Officer. Over time, you’ll be able to shape how security works across GetGround, including the standards, processes and future hires we need.

What you’ll do

  • Own our security posture. You’ll be the person accountable for security at GetGround. Assess where we are today and define a roadmap that balances security with what the business needs. Be pragmatic: understand our stage, what risk we can accept for now and what has to be fixed today. Keep leadership informed about our risks, what you need and how we’ll address them.

  • Stay ahead of threats. The threat landscape is moving faster than ever, and AI is driving much of that change. AI-generated phishing, deepfake social engineering, prompt injection and data leaking through AI tools are all part of it. Track what’s emerging, judge what matters to a regulated fintech and act before it reaches us.

  • Run our SIEM and own our alerts. Make sure logs from GCP, identity, endpoints, SaaS tools and our own platform reach the SIEM and stay there. Write detection rules, map coverage against MITRE ATT&CK, tune out the noise and make sure nothing important goes unnoticed.

  • Automate response. Build playbooks that contain common threats as soon as an alert fires. Lead incident response when things go wrong, and make sure we learn from it.

  • Protect the data we hold. Know where sensitive data lives, who can access it and when it moves. Secure every channel it passes through: devices through endpoint detection and response (EDR) and anti-malware monitoring and protection, email and cloud storage through data loss prevention, and our platform and tools through access controls. Make the secure path the easy path for everyone at GetGround.

  • Work across the business. Partner with our site reliability engineer and product engineers on secure infrastructure and design, and with Compliance on our obligations. Assess vendors and run training people actually remember.

  • Set our policies and back them with working controls. Build and keep updating our security policies, best practices and information security management system (ISMS). Implement and automate the technical controls behind our security certifications and frameworks, such as ISO 27001, so that passing an audit reflects how we really operate.

What you bring

  • Hands-on detection and response experience. You’ve run a SIEM, built detection rules and owned alerting in production. You know what a bad log looks like.

  • A habit of staying current. You follow how attackers are using AI and other new techniques. You turn what you learn into concrete defences, not headlines.

  • Cloud security depth. You understand cloud infrastructure, identity and networking well enough to harden them, ideally on GCP.

  • Endpoint and identity experience. You’ve run EDR, anti-malware and identity tooling across a company’s devices and SaaS estate.

  • An automation-first mindset. You’d rather automate a control or a response than do it by hand, and you use AI tools to multiply your output.

  • Judgement about risk. You can separate a real threat from a theoretical one, prioritise accordingly and explain the trade-off to people who aren’t specialists.

  • Ownership and clear communication. You take responsibility for outcomes, surface problems early and tell leadership plainly what you need. You can explain a security risk to an engineer, an auditor or the CEO.

Bonus

  • Experience in fintech, financial services or another FCA-regulated environment.

  • Experience implementing controls for security certifications such as ISO 27001.

  • Experience with SOAR tooling and infrastructure as code, such as Terraform.

  • Experience securing AI systems or LLM-based products.

  • Experience as the first or only security hire at a startup or scale-up.

  • Experience with UK GDPR or working alongside a Data Protection Officer.

  • Experience with identity and zero-trust controls, such as SSO, phishing-resistant MFA and conditional access.

  • Experience running penetration tests, red-team exercises or a bug bounty programme.

This role isn’t for you if

  • You want to stay in one specialism. In the same week you might write a detection rule, roll out a device policy and close a gap in our compliance controls.

  • You’re comfortable with alerts nobody reads. We want fewer, better alerts, and someone who cares whether they lead to action.

  • You see security as the department of no. We need someone who finds the secure way to ship, not someone who blocks the business by default.

  • You want a fully defined programme to execute. We need someone who can assess what exists, set the direction and take ownership of it.

  • You don’t connect with how we work. Our values—No BS, pursuit of excellence, feedback obsessed and healthy ego—mean communicating directly, holding a high bar, seeking feedback and being willing to change your mind.

Why join

  • Own security for a platform trusted with sensitive financial data by more than 30,000 investors.

  • Build our security function from the ground up as we expand internationally.

  • Work on challenging problems across cloud infrastructure, customer data, AI and regulated services.

  • Competitive salary and meaningful equity.

  • Hybrid London working, with three days per week in Waterloo.

  • Benefits include private health and dental cover, a learning budget, a home-office setup budget and 12 mental health days per year.

description: UFORCE exists to make aggression unaffordable. Founded in Ukraine and headquartered in London, UFORCE is a defence-technology company with operations across Europe, the United States and Asia. UFORCE builds uncrewed vessels, ground robotics and aircraft, autonomy software, and the command-and-control layer that operates them together. Each platform is deployable on its own, and stronger as part of the system. Its product lines include the MAGURA family of uncrewed surface vessels, the NEMESIS family of strike platforms, the LIUT family of ground robotic platforms, and counter-UAS systems. You’ll work alongside engineers, operators and customers during trials, demonstrations, training and deployments, resolving issues and turning field experience into practical improvements. Software is your primary discipline, but this is not a desk-based software role. It’s a hands-on, deployed position where you’ll work across the wider system, from networking and communications to equipment setup and operator workflows. You don’t need deep mechanical, marine or electronics expertise. We’re looking for strong software skills, practical operational experience and the ability to learn quickly. The role is a remote based role, with regular travel to field sites and customer locations locally and internationally. Manage the software side of deployments, including baselines, versions, configuration control, release notes, validation checks, and rollback and recovery procedures. Diagnose faults across the whole deployed system using structured fault isolation, separating software, hardware, network, comms, power, sensor, configuration, operator, and environmental causes. Read logs, reproduce issues, test hypotheses, and capture clear evidence, then hand issues back to Engineering with enough context to act on them quickly. Write scripts and small tools that automate checks, validate configuration, parse logs, and reduce manual work in the field. Prepare for field activity by checking equipment, cabling, compute setup, spares, tools, checklists, and documentation. Support practical tasks beyond software, such as system setup and compute swaps, and improve preparation so deployments become faster and more repeatable. Turn field observations into clear feedback for Software, Product, Operations, and Engineering, closing the gap between what is built, what is deployed, and what the customer expects. Support operators and customers during demonstrations and training, explain technical issues clearly to both specialist and non-specialist audiences, and help customers become more self-sufficient after handover. Improve software readiness over time, including observability, release discipline, documentation, and knowledge transfer, so the field depends less on engineering reach-back. What We're Looking For Strong software engineering ability as your primary discipline, with skills in Python and/or C++ for debugging, log analysis, and system maintenance. You can read, write, and debug code and scripts and are comfortable with version control, APIs, services, and logs. Systems-minded judgment. You can explain interfaces, dependencies, and trade-offs across software, compute, networking, comms, sensors, hardware, and field operations, and you avoid assuming that every problem is a software problem. Experience deploying and configuring Linux-based software systems, including package management, services, containers, updates, rollbacks, and repeatable deployment methods. Practical field troubleshooting experience in deployed or operational settings, such as military or global operations, motorsport, field engineering, remote production, customer sites, maritime, robotics, aerospace, or automotive environments. Working knowledge of networking and integration, including TCP/IP, VLANs, routing, VPNs, DNS, DHCP, firewalls, and how to tell a software failure from a connectivity, sensor, or data-link problem. Operational discipline: you prepare thoroughly, use checklists, manage risk, escalate sensibly, and stay calm under pressure. Clear technical communication, including structured, unambiguous reporting that Engineering can act on and operators can understand. A team-first, high-ownership approach. You work well with a small, multidisciplinary team, including during extended deployments, and are willing to travel regularly and support field activity. Nice to Have Experience with robotics, uncrewed systems, autonomy or mission software, sensors, telemetry, operator interfaces, or defence trials. Experience deploying software to edge compute or in disconnected environments, including containers and orchestration, CI/CD, infrastructure automation, observability, and controlled updates. Familiarity with tools such as Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, Ansible, or Terraform. Experience representing a technical team in customer demonstrations, trials, training, or deployments. description: About Intelance Intelance is an independent technology, AI and cyber assurance firm based in the UK. Pharmaceutical buyers want proof that a platform producing trial and regulatory outputs works reliably, keeps a full audit trail and would stand up to an inspection. raw.description:
- About Quandela:

Quandela is a European deeptech scale-up developing modular, scalable and energy-efficient photonic and spin-optical quantum computers, accessible through the cloud and on-premises.

With over 140 employees, we develop our own hardware and software stack, from semiconductor quantum emitters and photonic processors to quantum control systems and algorithms.

Our ambition is to build large-scale, fault-tolerant quantum computers, combining quantum dot technologies, scalable spin-photon interfaces and distributed entanglement within future Spin-Optical Quantum Computing (SPOQC) architectures.

- About this position:

You will join Quandela's Semiconductor Optics Team, bringing together expertise in quantum optics, spin physics, semiconductor technologies and quantum information.

Your focus will be to develop and validate photon-mediated spin-spin entanglement protocols, improve spin coherence and operation fidelity, and advance optical control techniques for future hybrid quantum computing architectures.

We are looking for an experienced experimental scientist who can independently drive complex experimental activities, shape technical directions and translate scientific results into reliable technological building blocks, working closely with our research and engineering teams.

With several experimental building blocks still under development, you'll have room to shape technical choices, tackle open scientific challenges and directly influence our technology roadmap.

- What you'll do:

Spin-based quantum experiments

  • Design, develop and optimize optical experiments involving spin-photon sources.
  • Implement optical control schemes for spin initialization, readout and manipulation.
  • Characterize spin coherence, operation fidelity and entanglement quality.

Scientific and experimental ownership

  • Independently drive experimental investigations, from design to validation.
  • Structure and prioritize scientific activities, milestones and technical challenges.
  • Troubleshoot complex experimental systems and propose technical improvements.
  • Share expertise and support less experienced colleagues when relevant.

Technology development and integration

  • Develop and validate photon-mediated spin-spin entanglement protocols.
  • Collaborate with theory, electronics and semiconductor technology teams.
  • Improve experimental robustness, reproducibility and system performance.
  • Translate scientific results into demonstrators and technological building blocks for future multi-spin architectures.

- How You Will Grow:

During your first 3 months 
You will become familiar with Quandela's experimental platforms and ongoing demonstrators, contributing your expertise to current technical challenges.

Within 6 months 
You will drive dedicated experimental workstreams, contribute to key technical decisions and strengthen theory-to-experiment feedback loops.

Within 1 year 
You will help shape the team's experimental direction, advance distributed entanglement demonstrations and contribute to future spin-based architectures.

Requirements

- What we're looking for

We are looking for an experienced experimental researcher combining strong scientific expertise, technical autonomy and the ability to drive complex research activities.

Must-have

  • PhD in Spin Physics, Quantum Optics or a related field.
  • Hands-on experience with spin-based quantum systems (control, readout or coherence measurements).
  • Proven autonomy in designing, optimizing and troubleshooting complex quantum experiments.
  • Strong understanding of quantum optics, spin coherence and experimental measurement techniques.
  • Ability to lead scientific activities and make independent technical decisions.
  • Comfortable collaborating across experimental, theory and engineering teams

Important, but you can grow here

  • Photon-mediated entanglement protocols and multi-spin architectures.
  • Semiconductor quantum emitters, quantum dots and spin-photon interfaces.
  • Advanced optical control, cryogenic platforms and fast electronics.
  • Experimental qualification, system integration and technology transfer.

Bonus points

  • Experience bridging academic research and industrial R&D.
  • Experience coordinating scientific projects or mentoring researchers.

- Career Stage & Team Contribution: 

We primarily target candidates with a PhD and 4+ years of postdoctoral or equivalent R&D experience, combining scientific expertise with strong experimental autonomy.

Researchers completing a substantial postdoc are also welcome if they demonstrate scientific maturity, technical ownership and readiness for broader responsibilities.

People management experience is not required. What matters is your ability to drive scientific activities, tackle complex technical challenges and share your expertise with the team.

Benefits

  • Profit-sharing and a company savings plan. 
  • Public transport subscription covered at 50%. 
  • Annual sustainable mobility bonus for eco-friendly transport (e-bike, electric car). 
  • Fully covered health insurance (Alan). 
  • Referral program (€1,000 for a junior and €2,000 for an experienced candidate). 
  • Access to a nursery via choisir-ma-creche or contribution to childcare expenses. 
  • Subsidy for gym membership and sports activities (Gymlib). 
  • Meal subsidies (Swile). 

 Localisation of the position : Based at the IPVF campus in Palaiseau, within the Paris-Saclay research ecosystem. 

Process: 

  • Talent Acquisition Interview (30–45 min)
  • Hiring Manager Interview (45–60 min)
  • Technical discussion and presentation of previous research work

  • Reference checks
  • Offer

- Beyond That

Our spin-based platforms are still evolving, leaving room to explore new approaches, influence technical directions and take real ownership of experimental challenges.

title: GPU Engineer
description: About Kog At Kog, we're building real-time LLM inference for AI agents. Coding agents execute sequences of tasks where each step depends on the model's previous response. The faster the model generates tokens, the faster these agents can reason, code, and act. Our approach is to co-design model architecture, the inference engine, and low-level GPU kernels to minimize generation latency on standard NVIDIA and AMD datacenter GPUs. We've developed several technologies to make this possible: Monokernel: a persistent GPU program that keeps the entire token generation loop on the GPU, avoiding CPU handoffs. KCCL: our custom inter-GPU communication layer, designed to minimize latency. Delayed Tensor Parallelism (DTP): a model architecture that overlaps communication with computation and weight loading. Laneformer 2B: our code-generation model demonstrating this co-design approach. Our engineers work directly with GPU hardware, using CUDA, PTX, HIP, and CDNA ISA to optimize execution. Implementing and optimizing a new AI model for a specific GPU architecture can take months of manual engineering. Meanwhile, new models are constantly being released. Our goal is to use AI agents to implement and optimize the models we choose on the GPUs we choose, in a fraction of the time required today. These agents will build on the GPU optimizations and hardware insights our team has developed. They'll explore optimization strategies, generate and modify kernels, verify correctness, benchmark performance on real hardware, and iterate based on the results. We want to make model porting and GPU optimization much faster and repeatable, allowing Kog to keep pace with the latest AI models rather than spending months adapting each one manually. This is a major engineering direction we're now developing, and you'll help shape it. Learn more at https://blog.kog.ai . What you'll work on You'll join our GPU engineering team to tackle challenging performance problems and help build the internal agents that will accelerate this work. Develop and optimize GPU kernels using C++, CUDA, HIP, and low-level instructions. Investigate GPU architecture, memory access, synchronization, and execution bottlenecks. Profile and benchmark workloads to identify and validate performance improvements. Optimize inference operations and communication across multiple GPUs. Implement and optimize new AI models on NVIDIA and AMD GPUs. Help build AI agents for GPU engineering , enabling automated code optimization, correctness testing, benchmarking, and iterative improvements. Take ownership of technical decisions and their implementation. What we're looking for We're looking for an experienced GPU Engineer who can contribute quickly and independently to complex performance problems. Strong hands-on experience developing and optimizing GPU kernels, ideally using CUDA C++ or HIP/ROCm. Deep understanding of GPU architecture, memory hierarchy, parallel execution, and performance bottlenecks. Strong C++ skills and experience profiling and benchmarking GPU workloads. Proven ownership of challenging technical projects, from implementation to measured results. Interest in developing AI agents and tools to accelerate GPU engineering. Experience with PTX, CDNA ISA, multi-GPU systems, low-latency inference, or GPU performance portability is particularly valuable. A PhD in HPC, computer science, or a related field is a plus when backed by substantial engineering work. Previous experience building AI agents is not required.
