title: Medior/Senior Full Stack Developer
description: Do you want to work in a dynamic environment where your code really makes a difference? Are you a passionate developer who enjoys tackling complex technical challenges? Join the Customer Champions team and create a world-class app in which all the value of the Momo platform comes together. Help us create reusable, and above all, user-friendly components and interactions that make caregivers love the app. Who is Momo? Momo Medical is a fast-growing and ambitious scale-up, tackling one of the biggest societal challenges: the future of elderly care. Over the next decade, demand for care is expected to double, while 30% of the current workforce is projected to retire. Our innovative solutions aim to reduce the pressure on healthcare workers while improving the quality of care for residents. The most valuable aspects of the role 🚀 Your work defines the way caregivers interact with the app as well as how it looks . All while staying in very close contact with them to understand exactly what they need.  ⚓ Work together with many teams , such as production, customer success, and hardware, to translate real-world problems into reliable software. 💛 You contribute to better care for nursing home residents and help reduce the workload for healthcare professionals .   📍 You’re available 32 - 40 hours per week and happy to spend at least 4 days per week with the team in Delft.  🎊 Thursday pizza nights, Friday drinks, team activities, travel allowance, pension plan, and plenty of growth opportunities that match your ambitions. Your key responsibilities As part of a multidisciplinary team you will work on innovative solutions that have a direct impact on healthcare professionals in the Netherlands and abroad. You will have the opportunity to develop your skills, specialize or grow into a team leader role. You can work on the front-end or the back-end, or even better: both! Your key responsibilities include: Maintain and improve the connection between business logic and UI in our Flutter app by employing Bloc and Clean Architecture. Design, build, and maintain TypeScript services that drive the app to thousands of phones simultaneously. . Design event-driven systems that provide the app with the freshest data possible Automate manual workflows and improve reliability through observability, testing, and CI/CD. Mentor teammates, set technical direction, and help prioritize the roadmap. Who are you? You have an advanced skill set of Flutter, Node, and TypeScript , backed by a track record of delivering full-stack features end-to-end in fast-paced environments. You validate your features with automated tests , ranging from unit-tests to fully automated widget tests and end-to-end tests. You’re comfortable modelling data and tuning performance in relational databases such as PostgreSQL. A good level of English is required, and it is a plus if you can speak Dutch.  You enjoy collaborating with colleagues across the company and keeping multiple initiatives moving forward. Y ou’re available 32–40 hours per week and happy to spend at least four days a week with the team in Delft. Why join Momo Medical? Because you want to make a difference in healthcare at home and abroad. Because you are excited about a fast-growing scale-up where no two days are the same. And because you want to work with young, enthusiastic and talented international colleagues who all work hard to make healthcare a little bit better every day. Salary: €4,000–5,000 (medior) or €5,000–6,000 (senior) per month based on 40 hours, plus 8% holiday allowance. 30 vacation days per year to pick your own holidays (celebrate Christmas, Eid Al-Fitr, or any other holiday of your choice!). Hybrid working, and a laptop of your choice. Pension plan and travel reimbursement Guided mentorship and clear paths toward tech lead or specialist roles. Provided lunches, weekly company drinks and dinners, and regular team and company events. Reimbursement of travel expenses and a pension plan Good to know Tech at Momo At Momo, we use the following tools: Flutter, Swift, Kotlin, JavaScript, React, TypeScript, Express, Vitest, Node, PostgreSQL, Docker, Testcontainers, GitHub, and AWS. What are the next steps? First, we’ll review your CV and motivation to get a sense of how you are and to envision how you might fit within our team. After that, you’ll receive a short take-home assignment that helps us understand how you think, and you get insights into the kind of work we do at Momo. The next step is a chat at our offices in Delft, where we can go more in-depth on the role, the team and the Momo culture. Then, as a final exploration, you’ll have the chance to spend a work-along day with us to experience a day at Momo and to meet more people working on the same mission. When both you and we see the match, we’ll share an offer and start the onboarding process so you can join us in supporting caregivers! Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

As part of a multidisciplinary team you will work on innovative solutions that have a direct impact on healthcare professionals in the Netherlands and abroad. You will have the opportunity to develop your skills, specialize or grow into a team leader role. You can work on the front-end or the back-end, or even better: both!

Your key responsibilities include:

  • Maintain and improve the connection between business logic and UI in our Flutter app by employing Bloc and Clean Architecture.

  • Design, build, and maintain TypeScript services that drive the app to thousands of phones simultaneously. .

  • Design event-driven systems that provide the app with the freshest data possible

  • Automate manual workflows and improve reliability through observability, testing, and CI/CD.

  • Mentor teammates, set technical direction, and help prioritize the roadmap.

Who are you?

  • You have an advanced skill set of Flutter, Node, and TypeScript, backed by a track record of delivering full-stack features end-to-end in fast-paced environments.

  • You validate your features with automated tests, ranging from unit-tests to fully automated widget tests and end-to-end tests.

  • You’re comfortable modelling data and tuning performance in relational databases such as PostgreSQL.

  • A good level of English is required, and it is a plus if you can speak Dutch. 

  • You enjoy collaborating with colleagues across the company and keeping multiple initiatives moving forward.

  • You’re available 32–40 hours per week and happy to spend at least four days a week with the team in Delft.

Why join Momo Medical?

Because you want to make a difference in healthcare at home and abroad. Because you are excited about a fast-growing scale-up where no two days are the same. And because you want to work with young, enthusiastic and talented international colleagues who all work hard to make healthcare a little bit better every day.

  • Salary: €4,000–5,000 (medior) or €5,000–6,000 (senior) per month based on 40 hours, plus 8% holiday allowance.

  • Provided lunches, weekly company drinks and dinners, and regular team and company events.

Good to know

Tech at Momo

At Momo, we use the following tools: Flutter, Swift, Kotlin, JavaScript, React, TypeScript, Express, Vitest, Node, PostgreSQL, Docker, Testcontainers, GitHub, and AWS.

What are the next steps?

First, we’ll review your CV and motivation to get a sense of how you are and to envision how you might fit within our team. After that, you’ll receive a short take-home assignment that helps us understand how you think, and you get insights into the kind of work we do at Momo. The next step is a chat at our offices in Delft, where we can go more in-depth on the role, the team and the Momo culture. Then, as a final exploration, you’ll have the chance to spend a work-along day with us to experience a day at Momo and to meet more people working on the same mission. When both you and we see the match, we’ll share an offer and start the onboarding process so you can join us in supporting caregivers!

raw.title: Senior China Research Analyst
raw.description:
Datenna is a fast-growing tech scale-up combining cutting-edge OSINT and AI technologies to provide governments with critical insights into China's techno-economic landscape. Our platform transforms open-source intelligence into actionable insights through advanced data processing and analysis.


The Role:
Do you enjoy turning complex data into strategic insights that drive critical decisions? As a Senior China Research Analyst, you will lead analytical research projects for our government clients. You'll turn their most pressing questions about China's technology, industrial, and defence-industrial landscape into data-driven reports and the datasets behind them. You'll work with Datenna's data on patents, procurement, research funding, and companies, and go beyond it when a question demands, to find the patterns and connections that inform high-stakes policy and security decisions. 


You'll independently manage several client research projects at a time, from scoping through final delivery, using both qualitative and quantitative analysis across China's corporate, academic, defence, and technology sectors. Client questions often start ambiguous and open-ended, and topics range widely, from advanced materials to semiconductors and aerospace. You'll work through uncertainty, get up to speed quickly on unfamiliar technologies, design creative analytical approaches when the path isn't obvious, and refine your research direction as new information emerges. The role needs strong China expertise, Chinese-language research skills, the ability to work autonomously, and clear communication with senior government stakeholders. 

 

Your mission at Datenna:

  • Lead end-to-end research delivery: Take full ownership of research projects, from initial scoping and analysis through to final deliverables. 

  • Design the research: Turn open-ended client questions into sound research design, and build new analytical frameworks when standard methods don't fit. 

  • Build and analyse the evidence base: Work directly with Chinese-language sources and Datenna's data on entities, patents, procurement, and research funding to map the actors, links, and trends that answer the client's question. 

  • Set the quality bar: Review colleagues' deliverables independently, verify findings against the underlying data, and guide Analysts on their research approach. 

  • Work with AI, with judgement: Use AI-assisted research tools to work faster and at greater scale. You own the interpretation and verify every output. 

  • Contribute to the China Research Lab: The Lab is our exploratory research track. It develops the methods, tools, and data sources that shape where China research at Datenna is heading, and tests them through internal R&D. You will dedicate part of your time to Lab initiatives, such as prototyping a new analytical approach, scouting and testing new sources, or contributing to webinars and publications. 

  • Strengthen the data and product: Turn what you learn on client projects into data and product improvements, working with the Product and Data teams. 


What makes you a great candidate:
Core requirements 

  • Experience: 5–8 years of professional experience in China-focused research, analysis, or related fields. 

  • Deep China expertise: Strong knowledge of Chinese industry, economy, policy, the defence-industrial base, and the technology and research landscape. 

  • Analytical excellence: Exceptional pattern recognition and analytical skills to connect the dots between corporate, state, and military actors in China's techno-economic landscape. 

  • Comfort with ambiguity: Proven ability to tackle research questions where the analytical path isn't predetermined, designing creative approaches and adapting as you learn. 

  • Chinese language proficiency: Professional reading proficiency in Chinese (minimum HSK5, HSK6 preferred) to work directly with Chinese-language sources such as technical literature, patents, procurement notices, and policy documents, and to build and verify Chinese technical terminology for data retrieval. 

  • Self-directed project management: Proven ability to independently break down complex research questions, run several multi-week projects in parallel against fixed client deadlines, and deliver high-quality output with minimal oversight. 

  • Quality ownership: An evidence-first approach. You trace every claim back to its source records, catch inconsistencies in data and drafts, and review others' work independently and constructively. 

  • Communication skills: Strong written and verbal communication, including precise, concise English writing for an international readership. You are comfortable presenting complex analysis to senior government stakeholders and refining requirements through client dialogue. 

  • Methodological versatility: Proficiency in both qualitative and quantitative research methods. 


Technical skills 

  • Working proficiency in SQL and/or Python to query, clean, and structure large datasets, plus advanced Excel. 

  • Hands-on experience using LLM-based tools in research, with a clear sense of where their output needs human verification. 

  • Familiarity with data-quality work such as deduplication and entity resolution. 


Nice to have 

  • Experience in the technology, science, and research sector within governmental organisations, think tanks, or international corporate settings. 

  • Background conducting research for external clients or stakeholders. 

  • Experience analysing patents, public procurement, research funding, or corporate registry data. 

  • Experience collecting web data from Chinese-language sources, or with BI tools such as Metabase. 

  • A technical or scientific background (for example materials science, engineering, or physics) relevant to dual-use technology topics. 

*Please know that applicants may be subject to a screening process.*


  • Work on globally impactful projects in geopolitical intelligence

  • Lead innovation in OSINT and AI technologies

  • Competitive compensation and benefits

  • Dynamic, international team environment

  • Significant growth opportunities in a scale-up

title: Business Analyst - Enterprise & AI Solutions
description: <div class="content-intro"><h4><strong>Who We Are</strong></h4> <p>WPP Enterprise Solutions designs, builds, and operates the growth systems that competitive businesses rely on. In a world where Al is reshaping how companies drive growth, we lead clients in business transformation and marketing modernization, connecting strategy directly to execution. Our 12,000 experts in engineering and platforms, commerce, consulting, content transformation, CRM, and CX work within a unified global operating unit across 40+ markets. WPP Enterprise Solutions works alongside best-in-class partners including Adobe, AWS, Braze, Google, Microsoft, Salesforce, and Shopify, as well as innovators in AI, to deliver growth solutions tailored to the needs of our clients’ businesses. VML, part of WPP, supports WPP Enterprise Solutions by helping brands activate transformation through creativity and experience.</p></div><h3>Working in technology &amp; innovation with WPP Enterprise Solutions</h3> <p>At WPP Enterprise Solutions Netherlands, we create connected brands to drive growth. Our expertise spans the full customer journey, with deep capabilities in commerce, consultancy, CRM, CX, data, production, technology, content, media and more. We deliver end-to-end solutions for ambitious B2B and B2C brands, supported by the wider WPP network.</p> <p>Our work combines strategy, product thinking, experience design, data, engineering and AI to solve real business problems, from enterprise commerce modernisation and digital shelf excellence to AI-enabled content operations, marketing automation, GEO, workflow orchestration and custom AI agents.</p> <h3>About the team</h3> <p>You’ll join the Product Management &amp; AI Solutions team: the group that bridges business strategy, customer experience and technology to deliver scalable commerce and enterprise solutions. We work closely with UX/CX, Data &amp; AI, SEO/GEO, Content, CRM, Paid and Retail Media, Engineering and Delivery teams.</p> <p>Our ambition is to move beyond isolated skills and build repeatable, outcome-led propositions around commerce growth topics such as Search &amp; Discovery, Personalisation, CRO &amp; Experience Optimisation, Product Data/PIM &amp; Digital Shelf, Content Supply Chain &amp; AI Content Operations, CRM &amp; Lifecycle Growth, Performance &amp; Retail Media, SEO/GEO and Composable Commerce Modernisation. Alongside this, we are growing our applied AI work: shaping and delivering custom AI agents and AI-enabled workflows for clients, from discovery and pilot through to production and continuous improvement.</p> <h3>Why this role exists</h3> <p>Clients are increasingly asking for integrated solutions rather than isolated delivery capacity. They need people who can understand the business problem, shape the product direction, define the right solution, translate it into clear specifications and guide teams through delivery. At the same time, AI is changing how commerce, content, marketing and operations work, creating a need for analysts who can combine structured requirements thinking with product ownership, enterprise technology understanding and the design of AI-enabled workflows and agents.</p> <p>This role is designed for someone who can operate as a strong Business Analyst, step into Product Owner responsibilities when needed, advocate for product thinking inside the organisation and help turn our AI and commerce capabilities into scalable client value. You will work across both our commerce and enterprise product work and our applied AI work. The mix depends on client demand, and we expect the AI share to grow over time.</p> <h3>The role</h3> <p>As Business Analyst, Enterprise &amp; AI Solutions, you bridge business needs, product direction and technical delivery across enterprise digital commerce and martech ecosystems. You analyse business processes, clarify user and stakeholder needs, define requirements and support solutioning across the commerce stack: CMS, Search, PIM/PXM, DAM, ERP, OMS, CDP, CRM, analytics, marketing automation, paid/media platforms and integration layers.</p> <p>You will also work on AI initiatives such as custom AI agents (for example for pricing, search or customer service), content and marketing automation, product/content enrichment, GEO and organic discoverability, AI orchestration and workflow automation. You do not need to be a machine learning engineer or a domain expert, but you must be technically curious and comfortable working with APIs, data flows, automation tools, LLM-based workflows, AI quality evaluation, governance requirements and human-in-the-loop processes.</p> <p>Depending on your experience and the project context, you may act as a hands-on BA, a product-minded discovery partner, a proxy Product Owner or a work stream lead. In all cases, your job is to make ambiguity manageable, decisions explicit and delivery focused on measurable value.</p> <h3>What you will do</h3> <ul> <li>Collaborate with Solution Architects and Product Owners and translate business goals into clear requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, tech architecture, data flows and integration specifications that delivery teams can act on.</li> <li>Work across commerce, martech and enterprise ecosystems, including CMS, Search, PIM/PXM, DAM, ERP, OMS, CDP, CRM, analytics, marketing automation and media platforms.</li> <li>Identify, shape and specify practical AI, automation and workflow orchestration opportunities across content, marketing, commerce and operational processes, from process mapping and readiness checks to a scoped pilot with a clear business case.</li> <li>Specify AI agents and LLM-based workflows: define the task, data sources, tools and integrations, guardrails, human-in-the-loop steps and escalation paths, plus the evaluation criteria that decide when a solution is ready to go live. After launch, help measure quality, adoption and business impact.</li> <li>Act as a Business Analyst or proxy Product Owner when needed by supporting prioritisation, backlog refinement, sprint planning, UAT, release preparation and stakeholder alignment.</li> <li>Connect business, UX, data, SEO/GEO, content, engineering, legal and delivery teams to make sure solutions are valuable, feasible, scalable and well governed.</li> <li>Help make our AI work repeatable and sellable: contribute to proposals, scoping and estimates, and build reusable assets such as discovery templates, requirement patterns, evaluation sets and playbooks.</li> <li>At the senior end of the role, independently lead workstreams, own parts of the client relationship and coach junior analysts or product team members.</li> </ul> <h3>Who you are</h3> <ul> <li>A structured problem-solver who starts with the business problem, not only the requested feature.</li> <li>A product-minded Business Analyst who can move between discovery, specification, prioritisation and delivery support.</li> <li>Comfortable acting as a proxy Product Owner when a project needs stronger product ownership.</li> <li>Technically fluent enough to discuss APIs, data flows, integrations, platform dependencies and implementation trade-offs with engineering teams.</li> <li>Curious and pragmatic about AI: you use AI tools in your own work and understand the opportunity, but also the need for governance, quality, reliability and human oversight.</li> <li>Comfortable with fast-moving technology: you focus on the problem and the outcome rather than a specific tool, and you pick up new platforms quickly.</li> <li>Strong in workshops, stakeholder alignment and decision-making, with the confidence to challenge constructively.</li> <li>Able to represent the Product Management &amp; AI Solutions team inside WPP and help other teams understand the value of product thinking and applied AI.</li> <li>Commercially aware: you can connect requirements and solutions to client value, efficiency, scalability, conversion, discoverability or operational impact.</li> <li>Collaborative and low-ego, with the ability to work across Commerce, UX/CX, Data, SEO/GEO, Content, CRM, Media, Engineering and Delivery.</li> </ul> <h3>What you’ll need</h3> <h4>The basics</h4> <ul> <li>3-5 years of experience as a Business Analyst, Product Owner, Solution Analyst or similar role, ideally in commerce, martech, enterprise platforms, consulting or a digital agency environment.</li> <li>Experience with digital commerce ecosystems, preferably B2B and/or B2C enterprise environments.</li> <li>Working knowledge of platforms and domains such as CMS, Search, PIM/PXM, DAM, ERP, OMS, CDP, CRM, analytics, marketing automation and paid/media technology.</li> <li>Strong experience writing user stories, acceptance criteria, functional specifications, process flows and integration requirements.</li> <li>Good technical understanding of REST APIs, web platforms, data flows, system integrations and common delivery dependencies.</li> <li>Hands-on familiarity with generative AI tools and a working understanding of how LLM-based solutions behave, including their limitations and how to test the quality of their output.</li> <li>Experience working in Agile delivery environments with tools such as Jira, Confluence or similar.</li> <li>Excellent communication, facilitation, documentation and stakeholder management skills.</li> <li>Fluent professional English.</li> <li>Currently residing in the Netherlands with a valid work permit.</li> </ul> <h3>Bonus points</h3> <ul> <li>Hands-on experience with automation tools such as n8n, Zapier or similar.</li> <li>Experience shaping AI, LLM, agentic or workflow orchestration use cases in a business or delivery context, ideally including at least one that went live.</li> <li>Familiarity with AI and agent platforms such as Microsoft Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI or the OpenAI and Anthropic APIs, and with concepts such as retrieval (RAG), tool use and evaluation.</li> <li>Familiarity with AI governance and regulation, such as the EU AI Act, and with responsible AI practices.</li> <li>Experience with search and personalisation platforms, composable commerce, PIM/PXM, CDP, CRM or marketing automation platforms.</li> <li>Experience with GA4, BigQuery, SQL, Python, Postman, Figma, Miro or similar tools.</li> <li>Proficiency in Dutch.</li> </ul> <h3>In return, this is what we offer</h3> <p>You’ll get access to an international network of clients, colleagues, technology partners and resources. We have a listening ear for ambitious ideas, and together we keep stretching our boundaries. We want you to follow the path you’re building, and we invest in your personal development in a dynamic, collaborative workplace.</p> <h2>Our compensation</h2> <ul> <li>A monthly salary between <strong>€4,800 and €5200</strong>&nbsp;gross, depending on your experience, seniority and fit with the role.</li> <li>A gross annual 8% holiday allowance.</li> <li>Access to our commuting package to suit your individual needs.</li> <li>Competitive pension benefits.</li> <li>A choice of a Mac or Windows laptop.</li> </ul> <h2>Our culture</h2> <ul> <li>A culture of trust, with a feel-at-home vibe and an international environment.</li> <li>Mental health support, including complimentary membership EAP counselling services.</li> <li>Wellness benefits (when available) including yoga classes, an in-house masseuse.</li> <li>The opportunity to work with a renowned international customer base of B2B and B2C brands.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>About WPP</strong></h4> <p class="p1">WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence and world-class partnerships – all united by our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit <a href="http://wpp.com/"><span class="s1">WPP.com</span></a><span class="s2">.</span></p> <p><span class="normaltextrun"><span lang="EN-GB">WPP (VML/WPP Enterprise Solutions) is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.</span></span><span class="scxw176048299"><span lang="EN-GB">&nbsp;</span></span></p> <p>When you click "Submit Application", this will send any information you add below to WPP (VML/WPP Enterprise Solutions). Before you do this, we think it's a good idea to read through our <a href="https://www.vml.com/recruitment-privacy-policy">Recruitment Privacy Policy</a>. California residents should read our&nbsp;<a href="https://www.vml.com/california-recruitment-privacy-notice">California Recruitment Privacy Notice</a>. This explains what we do with your personal data when you apply for a role with us, and, how you can update the information you have provided us with or how to remove it.</p></div> Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

raw.description:
Location: Zaltbommel, Netherlands (Hybrid)

Reporting to: VP of Marketing


About Cyclomedia & The Role

Cyclomedia creates digital representations of the real world, giving professionals the visual data they need to manage assets and infrastructure. We are currently sharpening our commercial strategy. To drive this, we are looking for a Product Marketing Manager to bridge the gap between our product capabilities and the market.

In our setup, Product Management builds the solution, and Product Marketing wins the market. As part of the Marketing department, you keep our messaging strictly focused on customer value. You own the value propositions, the customer context, and the commercial message. Your output forms the foundation for all our demand generation campaigns.

The Role & Collaboration

As the owner of our value propositions, you define the go-to-market approach. You build this strategy through direct contact with customers and close alignment with sales and Product Management. Armed with this market reality, you brief our Regional Marketing Managers and Content Marketers on the target audiences, messaging, and commercial hooks required for their campaigns. You also work with our Sales Enablement team to ensure sales representatives have the materials they need to close deals.

Key Responsibilities

  • Positioning & Messaging: Translate technical product capabilities into clear positioning and go-to-market strategies that drive pipeline value and improve lead conversion rates.

  • Market Intelligence: Feed the product roadmap with market insights, buyer needs, and competitive intelligence.

  • Sales Alignment: Validate marketing materials with regional sales teams so they are fully equipped to sell the solution.

  • First 6 Months Impact: Work out the context for our top 6 value propositions and produce the foundational global marketing materials to guide upcoming demand and lead generation campaigns.

Your Profile

  • Experience: 5+ years of Product Marketing experience, or a strong commercial background deeply embedded in our core markets.

  • Domain Expertise (Preferred): A background in Geographic Information Systems (GIS) or mobile mapping, or specific industry experience in utility companies, telecom network planning, public or network asset management, or engineering work planning.

  • Commercial Acumen: A proven ability to look from the outside in. You base your strategies on what the buyer needs to hear rather than what the product can do.

  • Ownership: You work independently and possess the maturity to help shape the Product Marketing function as we grow.

What We Offer

  • Room to make your mark: A challenging role in a strong, growing international company, with real freedom to shape the position.

  • A great team to join: A small, close-knit and growing marketing team, plus experienced colleagues to build on.

  • A competitive package: An attractive base salary and an 8.3% annual bonus scheme.

  • Growth: Training, online courses and (team) coaching to support your development.

  • Time off: 25 holidays, the option to buy up to 10 extra days a year, and an extra day off after Ascension Day.

  • Wellbeing: A flexible Mental Health Day each year to rest and recharge, and a sports allowance of €25 gross per month.

  • Hybrid working: 3 days in the office and 2 from home, with a home-working allowance of €2 per day.

  • The right tools: A company phone and laptop.

raw.title: ML Infrastructure & Acceleration Engineer - LLMs
raw.description:
Who We Are

You've ordered dinner through Just Eat Takeaway. You've bought and sold on OLX. You've paid with PayU. Chances are, you've already used a Prosus company today.

We are Prosus, a global technology company powering some of the world's leading lifestyle ecommerce businesses. Every day, billions of people across India, Latin America, Europe and beyond use our products and services to buy, sell, pay, connect and discover.

Our AI-driven ecosystem spans 100+ companies across ecommerce, food delivery, fintech and experiences, serving billions of consumers worldwide. AI powers how we operate and innovate, with more than 60,000 active AI agents helping our teams build, scale and move faster. Through our investment team, we also back the founders and technologies shaping the future: From robotics and autonomous systems to synthetic biology and frontier AI.

Guided by our five values Innovation, Results, People, Impact, and Entrepreneurship, culture is our competitive advantage. We thrive with experimentation; we build, we test, we learn, we iterate.

Join us in shaping the future of technology at global scale.

Who we're looking for

We're seeking an experienced ML Infrastructure & Acceleration Engineer to own the GPU infrastructure that powers our LLM training and serving, and to make every workload on it faster and cheaper. You'll run our H200 cluster end to end, deploy models to production, and profile and optimize our training and inference pipelines down to the kernel level when it matters. You understand GPUs from the cluster scheduler to the memory hierarchy, you measure before you optimize, and you're motivated by turning raw compute into faster iteration for our ML team. You thrive in environments where infrastructure reliability and efficiency directly shape how quickly research reaches millions of users.

What you'll do

GPU Cluster & Infrastructure:

  • Own our H200 GPU cluster end to end: Kubernetes and Slurm for training and inference workloads, with multi-tenant scheduling, quotas, and resource isolation

  • Keep large distributed training runs healthy: node health checks, NCCL and interconnect debugging, automated job recovery, and checkpoint management

  • Track and optimize GPU utilization and cost across training and inference, with dashboards and budget alerting

  • Manage infrastructure-as-code and provisioning for GPU environments

  • Define and monitor SLIs/SLOs for cluster availability and production model serving

Deployment & Serving:

  • Deploy LLMs to production using vLLM or SGLang, with CI/CD, model versioning, and safe rollouts and rollbacks

  • Monitor serving latency, throughput, errors, and cost, and act on regressions

ML Acceleration:

  • Profile training and inference end to end (PyTorch Profiler, Nsight Systems, Nsight Compute) to find and remove bottlenecks

  • Improve training throughput and MFU: parallelism strategies (FSDP, tensor and pipeline parallelism), communication/compute overlap, mixed precision and FP8, activation checkpointing, torch.compile

  • Optimize inference: quantization (FP8, INT8, INT4), speculative decoding, prefix caching, continuous batching, KV cache tuning, and parallelism layouts

  • Write or integrate fused and custom kernels (Triton, CUDA) where off-the-shelf implementations fall short

  • Build benchmarking tooling so every optimization ships with measured gains

Enablement & Best Practices:

  • Partner with ML engineers and researchers to make training and serving efficient by default

  • Establish best practices for using the cluster and guide teams in their adoption

Minimum qualifications

  • 5+ years in ML infrastructure, MLOps, HPC, or platform engineering with focus on GPU workloads

  • Hands-on experience operating multi-node GPU clusters with Kubernetes and/or Slurm, including debugging hardware, networking (NCCL, InfiniBand/RoCE), and job failures

  • Production experience deploying and optimizing LLM inference with vLLM, SGLang, or TensorRT-LLM

  • Proven track record of profiling and accelerating GPU workloads, with measured results in throughput, latency, MFU, or cost

  • Solid understanding of monitoring and observability for GPU systems (Prometheus, Grafana, DCGM, or similar)

  • Naturally curious with a track record of proactively identifying and implementing improvements

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience writing custom kernels in Triton or CUDA, and familiarity with fused kernels such as FlashAttention

  • Performance tuning of distributed training frameworks: FSDP, Megatron-LM, or DeepSpeed

  • Experience with low-precision training and inference (**FP8**, INT4) and model compression for production deployment

  • Deep knowledge of GPU architectures: memory hierarchy, tensor cores, roofline analysis

  • Experience with multi-tenant GPU scheduling and fair-share resource allocation

  • Contributions to open-source projects such as vLLM, SGLang, PyTorch, or Triton

What we offer

  • Critical infrastructure ownership for high-impact AI projects that are strategically vital to the company, with direct visibility to senior leadership including the CEO

  • State-of-the-art GPU infrastructure: H200 fleet, vLLM serving stack, and the freedom to optimize it end to end

  • Expert ML team who have released top Hugging Face models, published at NeurIPS, and built production systems that will run on your infrastructure

  • Significant autonomy in choosing tools and shaping our infrastructure and performance strategy

  • Modern tooling: Latest ML frameworks, coding assistants, best-in-class development environment

  • Hybrid work model with our Amsterdam office - home to the AI House, bringing together 200+ AI professionals through events and collaborations

  • Competitive compensation, top-spec MacBook Pro, and an environment genuinely built for professional growth and learning

If you're excited to own the GPU infrastructure behind cutting-edge LLMs and make every training run and every request faster, let's talk.

Why Prosus?

At Prosus, your colleagues include 60,000 AI agents… and your job is to figure out what that actually means. We're one of the largest operators of agentic AI on the planet, inside a $100B+ portfolio across 100+ companies and two billion people. The humans here own what AI can't do alone: judgment, creativity, and the call on what gets built next.

raw.description:
Who We Are

You've ordered dinner through Just Eat Takeaway. You've bought and sold on OLX. You've paid with PayU. Chances are, you've already used a Prosus company today.

We are Prosus, a global technology company powering some of the world's leading lifestyle ecommerce businesses. Every day, billions of people across India, Latin America, Europe and beyond use our products and services to buy, sell, pay, connect and discover.

Our AI-driven ecosystem spans 100+ companies across ecommerce, food delivery, fintech and experiences, serving billions of consumers worldwide. AI powers how we operate and innovate, with more than 60,000 active AI agents helping our teams build, scale and move faster. Through our investment team, we also back the founders and technologies shaping the future: From robotics and autonomous systems to synthetic biology and frontier AI.

Guided by our five values Innovation, Results, People, Impact, and Entrepreneurship, culture is our competitive advantage. We thrive with experimentation; we build, we test, we learn, we iterate.

Join us in shaping the future of technology at global scale.

About the role

Group Communications supports senior leadership and works across a wide network of portfolio companies, partners and AI initiatives. We want to get much better at using AI tools and data to track what is said about us, manage our relationships, and measure the value of our work.

You will join the team as a hands-on AI intern. You will set up tools, build simple workflows and give the team the insight it needs to make decisions faster. It is a practical role with real ownership and direct exposure to senior leaders.

Help the Group Communications team use AI and data to work smarter: set up media monitoring, build a shared stakeholder CRM and track the metrics that show our impact.

Priority use cases

1. Media monitoring platform

  • Help assess, set up and configure a media monitoring platform, using AI for tagging, sentiment and summaries.

  • Define the search terms, sources and alerts for the Group, key executives and priority topics.

  • Produce regular media summaries and flag emerging issues or opportunities to the team.

  • Test AI tools that make monitoring faster and more accurate, and recommend improvements.

2. Stakeholder CRM: Ventures, Illuminate, AI House India, AI House Amsterdam

  • Design and build a simple, shared CRM for contacts, partners, media and events across the four areas.

  • Consolidate existing contact lists, clean the data, and set clear rules for how the team keeps it current.

  • Use AI to enrich records, log interactions and surface follow-ups.

  • Train team members to use it and make sure it meets data privacy (GDPR) requirements.

3. Metrics and data tracking

  • Agree a core set of communications KPIs with the team, for example reach, share of voice, sentiment, engagement and event outcomes.

  • Build a dashboard that pulls data from monitoring, social and CRM sources.

  • Produce monthly and quarterly reporting with clear insights for leadership.

  • Automate data collection and reporting where possible to save the team time.

What success looks like

  • First 3 months: media monitoring is live with regular summaries, and the CRM structure is agreed and populated.

  • By the end of the internship: the team uses the CRM day to day, a KPI dashboard is in place, and there is clear handover documentation so the tools keep running.

What you bring

  • A current student or recent graduate in communications, data, business, computer science or a related field.

  • Hands-on experience with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude or Copilot and curiosity about how to apply them.

  • Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills and comfort working with data.

  • A structured way of working, with the ability to turn messy information into clear systems.

  • Clear written English and the confidence to work with senior stakeholders.

Nice to have

  • Experience with a CRM (for example HubSpot, Salesforce or Airtable) or a media monitoring tool (for example Meltwater or Cision).

  • Dashboarding skills in Power BI, Looker Studio or Tableau.

  • Basic automation or scripting, for example Zapier, Power Automate or Python.

description: De IT-afdeling van Den Hartogh (25 collega's) werkt als één team aan de groei en doelstellingen van ons familiebedrijf, verdeeld over clusters als IT Operations, Architecture & Security en Data Integration & Analytics. Als Data Engineer binnen dat laatste cluster help je de business proactief bij het behalen van haar zakelijke en financiële doelen, met data in de breedste zin van het woord. Via applicaties, dashboarding en ad-hocanalyses moderniseer je ons datalandschap, en er is volop ruimte om te innoveren met predictive & generative AI, Data Science en Process Automation (RPA) . Je rapporteert rechtstreeks aan de Teamlead Data Integration & Analytics. Wat ga je doen? Je slaat de brug tussen organisatie en processen enerzijds en techniek anderzijds; Als sparringpartner voor de business til je de managementinformatie naar een hoger niveau, in innovatieve en complexe dataprojecten; Je onderhoudt en breidt onze data pipelines in SQL uit en bouwt een semantisch model ; Je voert ad-hocanalyses uit met SQL (en R) en stimuleert continue verbetering via data- en procesanalyse; Je werkt nauw samen met data professionals om de bruikbaarheid van interne en externe data te verbeteren. Jij bent onze ideale kandidaat als je: Een bachelor of master hebt in Technische Bedrijfskunde, Business IT & Management, Data Science, Analytics of vergelijkbaar; Minimaal 4 jaar ervaring hebt in een vergelijkbare functie én minimaal 4 jaar met SQL ; Sterk bent in SQL, DAX, dimensioneel modelleren, data vault modeling, versiebeheer en Scrum ; Uitstekend communiceert in Nederlands en Engels (woord en geschrift) en een scherpe, kritische blik hebt, daarnaast durf je tegen de business aan te schuren; Proactief en resultaatgericht bent, met een sterke drive om te blijven verbeteren en jezelf te ontwikkelen; Pré : 2+ jaar ervaring met Machine Learning-modellen, geavanceerde Power BI-kennis en ervaring met het implementeren van AI-modellen in een organisatie. Wat bieden wij? Een salaris tussen € 4.000,- en € 5.400,- bruto per maand (naar kennis en ervaring), plus laptop en telefoon van de zaak, 30 vakantiedagen (o.b.v. fulltime), 8% vakantiegeld , een feestdagengratificatie van € 550,- bruto, reiskostenvergoeding en een goede pensioenregeling; Ruimte om te ondernemen : een uitdagende functie met veel zelfstandigheid, flexibiliteit en verantwoordelijkheid, binnen een groeiende en informele organisatie met ambitieuze doelen; Hybride werken vanuit ons Basecamp in Rotterdam (bij fulltime 3 dagen kantoor, 2 thuis): een moderne werkomgeving met uitzicht over de Waterweg, een inhouse gym, restaurant en de Den Hartogh Academy met meer dan 500 trainingen; Een internationale, maar familiaire werkomgeving, met betrokken collega's van over de hele wereld; Oog voor elkaar : een fijne werksfeer, een caring- en vitaliteitsbudget en toegang tot Benefits at Work met aantrekkelijke kortingen. HOE JIJ ONS VERDER BRENGT Jij bent het gezicht van Toxic. Voor de veiligheidskundigen, managers en directies die met ons werken, word jij degene die ze kennen en vertrouwen. Je leert hun organisatie kennen, luistert naar wat er speelt en denkt mee over wat ze nodig hebben. Zo bouw je relaties die jaren meegaan, en groeit Toxic met je klanten mee. Je leert je klanten kennen: hun mensen, hun processen en wat er bij hen speelt. Zo word je hun vaste gesprekspartner en denk je mee over de volgende stap. Elke nieuwe relatie begint met een goed gesprek. De binnendienst en marketing plannen de afspraken, jij bereidt je voor en ontdekt wat een organisatie nodig heeft. Daarnaast zoek je zelf nieuwe kansen. In je demo's laat je zien hoe Toxic werkt en wat het oplevert. Gaat de vraag verder dan het standaardplatform? Dan werk je met collega's een oplossing op maat uit, met API-koppelingen en AI-toepassingen. Je bouwt relaties met veiligheidskundigen, inkopers en directie, brengt hun belangen samen in 1 voorstel en sluit deals met een hogere dealwaarde. Met strategische accountplannen houd je overzicht op je belangrijkste klanten. Je ziet kansen voor up- en cross-sell en herkent retentierisico's vroeg. Samen met Customer Success zorg je dat nieuwe klanten goed starten. Je houdt je pipeline en forecast actueel in Salesforce en deelt wat je bij klanten hoort met marketing en product. Je bouwt relaties met meerdere stakeholders tegelijk en beheerst het volledige salesproces, van eerste kennismaking tot getekend contract. Je stuurt op data en haalt je targets, met nieuwe klanten en binnen je eigen portefeuille. Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands. Je hoeft de markt nog niet te kennen. Klanten, stoffen en regelgeving leer je bij ons, van collega's die het vak door en door kennen. HIER TEKEN JE VOOR Je tekent voor een rol die past bij je ambitie. Een salaris vanaf €4.477 per maand, op basis van een werkweek van 36 uur. Een goede pensioenregeling via PGB, inclusief aanvullende partnerverzekering. Een leaseauto of een reiskostenvergoeding van €0,25 per kilometer, en een aantrekkelijke fietsregeling. title: Vestigingsmanager Onderwijs
description: Wil jij de verantwoordelijkheid over jouw eigen vestiging, leidinggeven aan een team én dagelijks impact maken op de ontwikkeling van jongeren? Bij Lyceo combineer je ondernemerschap, management en onderwijs in één rol. Je krijgt veel verantwoordelijkheid, volop vrijheid en de kans om zichtbaar bij te dragen aan de groei van leerlingen én jouw vestiging. Taken Maak het verschil als Vestigingsmanager Als Vestigingsmanager ben jij eindverantwoordelijk voor het succes van jouw Lyceo-vestiging. Dankzij jouw inzet krijgen leerlingen de begeleiding die hen helpt effectiever te leren, meer zelfvertrouwen te ontwikkelen en betere resultaten te behalen. Je runt jouw eigen vestiging als een ondernemer binnen de organisatie. Daarbij stuur je een team van studentbegeleiders aan, onderhoud je contact met ouders en scholen en zorg je ervoor dat de vestiging kwalitatief én organisatorisch optimaal presteert. Je bent dagelijks zichtbaar aanwezig, signaleert kansen in de regio en bouwt aan duurzame samenwerkingen met scholen en ouders. Daarnaast ben je actief onderdeel van de dagelijkse praktijk op de vestiging en ondersteun je leerlingen tijdens de huiswerkbegeleiding. Juist die combinatie van management en persoonlijke begeleiding maakt deze rol zo afwisselend en betekenisvol. Kortom, jij pakt de regie bij het: leidinggeven aan, coachen en ontwikkelen van een team studentbegeleiders; voeren van intake-, evaluatie- en adviesgesprekken met leerlingen en ouders; organiseren van roosters, administratie en plannen van aanpak; opbouwen en onderhouden van relaties met scholen en andere stakeholders in de regio; actief onderdeel zijn van de dagelijkse praktijk op de vestiging en leerlingen ondersteunen tijdens de huiswerkbegeleiding; realiseren van groei, kwaliteit en resultaat binnen jouw vestiging. Vereisten Voor deze vacature neem jij mee: Jij krijgt energie van het combineren van onderwijs, management en ondernemerschap. Je bent zelfstandig, besluitvaardig en voelt je verantwoordelijk voor het succes van jouw vestiging. Daarnaast weet je overzicht te bewaren, kansen te signaleren en relaties op te bouwen met leerlingen, ouders, scholen en collega's. Je begrijpt dat kwaliteit, betrokkenheid en resultaat hand in hand gaan. Ervaring in een leidinggevende, coördinerende of ondernemende rol helpt je om snel succesvol te zijn in deze functie. Vink jij deze checklist ook af? • hbo werk- en denkniveau; • affiniteit met het begeleiden en ontwikkelen van jongeren; • ondernemende instelling en verantwoordelijkheidsgevoel; • commercieel inzicht en oog voor groei en resultaat; • sterke organisatorische en communicatieve vaardigheden; • we zoeken kandidaten op goede reisafstand van jouw vestiging. We hebben momenteel kansen in de volgende plaatsen: Hengelo, Utrecht, Laren en Delft. Jouw werkgebied Lyceo heeft ruim 100 vestigingen en daarmee altijd een vestiging bij jou in de buurt. Wij zoeken vestigingsmanagers voor de regio’s: Bussum, Laren en Delft. Je bent dagelijks aanwezig binnen de vestiging en werkt nauw samen met leerlingen, ouders, begeleiders en onderwijsprofessionals. Daarnaast onderhoud je contact met scholen en andere betrokkenen in de regio en bouw je actief aan de groei en kwaliteit van de vestiging. Benefits Als gedreven vestigingsmanager kun jij rekenen op: Een zelfstandige managementfunctie met veel verantwoordelijkheid binnen een maatschappelijk betrokken en resultaatgerichte organisatie. Lyceo geeft je de ruimte om jouw eigen vestiging te runnen, ondersteunt je met professionele begeleiding en investeert actief in jouw ontwikkeling en groei. Op basis van een fulltime dienstverband krijg je daarbovenop: • volledig door Lyceo betaalde pensioenbijdrage van 6%; • variabele beloningsmogelijkheden gekoppeld aan resultaten en groei; • een jaarcontract voor 32 tot 40 uur per week, net wat past bij jouw situatie, met uitzicht op een vast dienstverband; • vrij tijdens de schoolvakanties*; • laptop en telefoon van de zaak; • volledige ov-vergoeding of reiskostenvergoeding per kilometer; • toegang tot de Lyceo Academie met diverse trainingen en opleidingen; • persoonlijke begeleiding door een clustermanager en een eigen buddy; • aantrekkelijke kortingen via Benefits At Work; • regelmatige borrels, teamuitjes en een jaarlijks feest; • betekenisvol werk, waarbij resultaat en impact hand in hand gaan. *Naast de meivakantie en de laatste week van de zomervakantie ben je tijdens alle schoolvakanties vrij. Hiervoor wordt maandelijks 5,77% ingehouden ter compensatie van deze bovenwettelijke vakantiedagen, naast de 25 wettelijke vakantiedagen. Je bouwt vakantiegeld en pensioen op over je volledige bruto maandsalaris. Werken bij Lyceo Wie werkt bij Lyceo, blijft leren. Lyceo is een toonaangevende landelijke organisatie in aanvullend onderwijs en helpt jaarlijks duizenden leerlingen via programma’s zoals huiswerkbegeleiding, bijspijkertrajecten, examentrainingen en lente- en zomerscholen. Als marktleider binnen dit domein is Lyceo volop in beweging. De organisatie groeit hard en heeft duidelijke ambities voor de toekomst. Je komt terecht in een betrokken en energiek team waarin samenwerking centraal staat, maar waar ook ruimte is voor initiatief, eigenaarschap en nieuwe ideeën. De impact is groot: scholen beoordelen Lyceo gemiddeld met een 8,5 of hoger. We zoeken continu naar de beste samenwerking tussen regulier en aanvullend onderwijs en doen er alles aan om ieder kind tot z’n recht te laten komen. Opening

WE CANNOT PROVIDE VISA SPONSORSHIP


Details

Preferred starting date: ASAP

Weekly availability: full-time (5 days/week)

Period: 6 months

Location: Aerospace Innovation Hub, Delft, the Netherlands


About the company

Fiducial is a young but fast-growing deep-tech start-up with big ambitions at the frontier of autonomy, perception, and defence. Currently, we are developing software for advanced on-board UAV situational awareness in military applications. Using low-cost and widely available sensors and compute, our solutions are built for scalability. From there, we plan to develop a line-up of interconnected solutions to safeguard European safety.

Our team consists of engineers that are passionate about the technology and solutions they develop. The only time most of us are not thinking about the technology is when we are asleep, and sometimes even then. Our team members have a background in different fields such as Aerospace Engineering, Computational Science and Engineering, Robotics and Computer Graphics. Our office is located in the Aerospace Innovation Hub, a start-up hub located on the TU Delft campus in the faculty of Aerospace Engineering.

We work closely with top-tier partners, ranging from government agencies and prime contractors to academic research institutes and other start-ups. Our projects span from large tender orders in collaboration with partners to low TRL research with government agencies. Whether through formal R&D programs or rapid prototyping tracks, we operate at the intersection of innovation and deployment.


Your role

If you’ve ever spent a weekend building a drone, tuning a flight controller, soldering a power harness, or figuring out why your FPV setup won’t arm, this internship is literally designed for you.

We’re looking for a hands-on builder who loves working with real hardware:

  • wiring sensors

  • mounting compute boards

  • setting up flight controllers

  • testing drones outdoors

  • fixing whatever breaks and making it better

If phrases like ArduPilot, PX4, Jetson, ESCs, power distribution, 3D printing, or FPV gear make you smile, you’re the kind of person we want.

This is not a “sit behind a desk” internship. You will be on the drones. You will be in the field. You will fly.


What you’ll do

  • Build and integrate hardware onto real drone platforms used in active R&D.

  • Work hands-on with flight controllers (ArduPilot) and compute boards (Jetson, Orange Pi).

  • Deploy and debug embedded perception software.

  • Solder, assemble, and prototype wiring, adapters, mounts, and housings.

  • 3D-print parts and quickly turn ideas into working physical prototypes.

  • Support and participate in drone flight tests (you’ll fly regularly).

  • Troubleshoot issues, iterate fast, and improve our hardware setups.

You’ll see your work fly, literally!


Who you are

  • You’ve built or flown drones / RC systems (any level counts).

  • You tinker with electronics, FPV, embedded software, or robotics.

  • You enjoy making physical things work.

  • You like fast iteration and getting your hands dirty.

  • Linux doesn’t scare you.

  • You are independent, curious, and resourceful.

We don’t care about grades, we care about what you’ve made.

Please include photos/links of:

  • your drone builds

  • FPV rigs

  • electronics projects

  • CAD/3D-printed parts

  • GitHub repos

  • anything that shows you build things

If you’ve ever crashed something, fixed it, and sent it back into the sky — you’ll fit right in.


Requirements

  • Enrolled in a relevant study (Aerospace, Robotics, Electrical, Mechatronics, Engineering etc.).

  • Linux basics.

  • Interest in UAVs, robotics, embedded systems, or autonomy.

  • English proficiency.

  • Organized and proactive.

Bonus:

driver’s license, drone pilot license, CAD, 3D printing, soldering, or flight experience.

What we offer

  • 1000 euro monthly compensation.

  • 10 vacation days during internship period.

  • (Really) flexible working hours and option to work from home 2 days per week.

  • Have a direct and significant influence on highly innovative products.

  • The opportunity to iterate quickly with tight feedback loops, close to the product. We are innovating, learning is to be expected.

  • Responsibility over the things you implement, you are the expert on what you build.

The application procedure

  • If after reading the above you are convinced you are the right person for the job, send us some information about yourself; this can be a resume, website or other source, as long as we get a clear impression of your background and skills.

  • We’ll get back to you ASAP. If we feel you could be a fit for the position, we’ll invite you for an informal introduction so we can get to know you, and equally important, you can get to know us. After this, a technical focused interview could follow.

  • If at this point we feel you are the person we are looking for, we’ll discuss the specifics (starting date and period).

  • Welcome to the team!

description: Hé stage topper! Kom jij, net als vele andere stagiaires, stagelopen bij Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed Hengelo? Dit wordt jouw stage Als stagiair bij Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed Hengelo ga je aan de slag op ons kantoor of op één van onze projecten. We kijken in overeenstemming welke afdeling of welk project het beste bij jou en/of de opdracht past. Tijdens je stage word je goed begeleid door één van onze collega’s en krijg je de ruimte om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen! Jij staat aan het stuur van je eigen ontwikkeling tijdens je stageperiode: Hoe meer jij wil leren, hoe meer jij kan leren! Naast dat je zelfstandig aan een opdracht kan werken wordt je ook begeleidt door een senior collega die jou alle kneepjes van het vak gaat leren. We hebben door heel ons werkgebied verschillende bouwen waar we ruimte hebben voor een stagiaire, stuur ons vooral een berichtje zodat we samen kunnen kijken wat passend is! Meer bij Dura Vermeer Dura Vermeer is een familiebedrijf. Een onafhankelijke bouwonderneming actief in woningbouw, utiliteitsbouw, infrastructuur en techniek in Nederland. Al sinds 1855 vormen onze onafhankelijkheid en langjarige continuïteit de basis voor onze strategie. Met een omzet van circa € 1,8 miljard en ruim 3.000 medewerkers behoren we tot de top van de Nederlandse bouwsector. Samen realiseren we prachtige projecten. Iconische, en soms ook alledaagse projecten waarmee we nieuwe antwoorden bieden op maatschappelijke vraagstukken. Waarmee we de beste oplossingen voor morgen garanderen en het verschil maken voor Nederland, juist op de langere termijn. We hebben stevige ambities – en daarvoor geldt dat we die alleen kunnen waarmaken dankzij onze mensen. Als beste werkgever maken wij ons er daarom hard voor dat jij elke dag opnieuw kiest voor Dura Vermeer. Dat jij net zo trots bent op wat we maken als wij dat zijn. Dat iedereen die bij ons werkt gelukkig is. Dat je bij ons jezelf kunt zijn, je veilig voelt en je kunt uitspreken. En dat je tot je recht komt. En het beste uit jezelf kunt halen. Hier zit je goed! Wij zijn Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed Hengelo, een ontwikkelende bouwer in het werkgebied Noord-, Oost- en Midden-Nederland. Als onderdeel van de divisie Bouw & Vastgoed combineren we de kracht van een groot bedrijf, met de fijne sfeer en cultuur van een kleinere organisatie. Bij ons vind je echte doeners en waarmakers. We ontwikkelen en bouwen, samen met onze klanten, partners en collega’s. Wat ons ons maakt? Gewoon dóen en gewóón doen. Dat zit er nou eenmaal in, en zie je terug in alles wat we doen. Wil jij nou werken op een plek waar vakmanschap, samenwerking en heel veel plezier samenkomen? Mooi! Wij zoeken nieuwe collega’s binnen onze disciplines ontwikkeling, woningbouw, utiliteitsbouw, renovatie & transformatie en beheer & exploitatie. Dit breng je mee Je volgt een MBO, HBO of WO opleiding (pre: opleiding Bouwkunde); Je bent proactief, nuchter en een harde werker, net als wij! Dit bieden wij jou Een stagevergoeding van €700 per maand op basis van 40 uren per week; Je krijgt ruimte voor eigen initiatieven; De beste collega’s om het vak van te leren en zij zorgen voor een ongekende goede werksfeer; Een familiebedrijf waarin we voor elkaar klaarstaan! Meer weten? Wij beantwoorden je vragen graag of denken graag met je mee voor het invullen van je stagewens.
